notes: ◎中級

description.zh: 本課程目的在提升學生溝通表達能力，並著重於創業思維與專業英文。從專業英語文學習及創業的角度，讓學生了解流程與架構並實際演練，藉此提升學生學習及未來工作所需要之英文能力。
description.en: This course aims to enhance communicative competence with special emphasis on entrepreneurial thinking and professional English skills. From the perspectives of learning English for specific purposes (ESP) and entrepreneurship, students will learn how to create, rehearse and effectively participate in a range of different scenarios for current academic and future career pursuits.

name.en: English for Innovation and Entrepreneurship I

notes: ◎中級

description.zh: 每天許多人規律運動、觀賞及討論賽事，若具備暢談體育以及運動相關俚語的英文能力，將十分有益於與英語人士交流。本課程將介紹學生適用於體育以及其他社交場合的英語單字（包含許多用於職場專業場合、不同於字面意思的運動俚語）。本課程能幫助學生更清楚地理解英語體育新聞、更周全地與英語人士談論體育、用更加批判性的思維來思考運動在英語世界的文化、語言、日常生活中扮演著怎樣重要的角色。
description.en: Because many people play, watch, and discuss sports every day, being able to talk about sports and to understand sports idioms is very helpful when interacting with English speakers. This course introduces students to English vocabulary that is useful for talking about sports, but also useful in other social situations. (For example, many sports idioms -- such as “to play hardball” and “to strike out” -- are used by businessmen in professional situations not directly related to sports). The class helps students to understand more clearly English news about sports, to talk more thoughtfully with English speakers about sports, and to think more critically about the important role that sports play in the culture, language, and everyday life of people in the English-speaking world.

notes: ◎高級

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調電資專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service Electrical Engineering and Computer Science students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

name.zh: 進階專業英文- 電資(一)
name.en: Advanced ESP (Electrical Engineering and Computer Science) I

notes: ◎高級

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生學術英文能力，課堂將引導學生透過不同的學術聽力訓練、閱讀學術文章、學術寫作練習、與學術口語訓練等，來增進學生於大學英語授課課堂中的課堂參與，以及整體學術能力的展現，並為未來專業職場上語言能力奠定良好基底。
description.en: This course is designed for undergraduate students to develop their academic English language skills for success in English-medium university coursework. This course will engage students with active participation in a variety of academic listening, reading, writing, and speaking activities that they would encounter in real-life academic university lectures and professional workplace environments.

notes: ◎高級

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

name.zh: 基礎英文閱讀與字彙(一)
name.en: Basic English Reading and Vocabulary I

notes: ◎初級

description.zh: 本課程培養學生職場必備的核心英文能力，主題包含英文履歷撰寫、商用英文書信、英文面試與簡報技巧、辦公室英文會話等。本課程同時加強學生基礎英文能力，如單字、文法、寫作等，並透過多元活動有系統性地發展英語溝通能力。
description.en: This course is designed to equip students with the necessary English communication skills in the workplace. The content will include English resume writing, business English, English interviews, briefing skills, and office English conversation. This course will also strengthen students’ basic English skills, such as vocabulary, grammar, and writing.

notes: ◎初級

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調工程專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。

description.en: The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

notes: ◎中級

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

notes: ◎中級

description.en: In order to cultivate the students’ comprehensive capabilities to use English, especially the listening comprehension and oral expression ability, different multimedia materials, including movies, songs, TV series, online interactional games, online aiding software, etc., are used to help students understand when and how to use language appropriately in various situations. description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.zh: 本課程主要包括下列主題：1.全球企業發展的外在環境、2.全球技術突破與創新產業、3.各國研發創新及品牌智財策略、4.IP產業建置、5.全球品牌智財市場、6.全球企業及其智財管理的規劃與移轉、7.創新研發的保護方式、8.協同合作與獨立作業的比較、9.兼顧節稅的智慧財產權開發模式、10.跨國視野下的法律議題、11.企業智財部門規劃、12.併購與智財授權管理、13.品牌智財的財務價值、14.著名全球企業智財管理模式。
description.en: This course will focus on the following topics: 1.external environments for corporate developments, 2.new technologies and innovative enterprises, 3. R&D and branding polices of major countries, 4. the establishment of IP industries, 5. global branding markets, 6. the plan and transfer of global enterprises & IP location, 7. the protection of R&D, 8.the choice between joint and individual R&D, 9. tax plan for IP development, 10.IP plan for international industries, 11, the establishment of IP department, 12.M&A and IP, 13.the evaluation of brands & IP, 14.the IP management of well-known global enterprises,

description.zh: 近年來，經濟學家，社會科學研究人員，政策制定者，商人和專業人士已開始在中觀和宏觀層面上使用專利信息。這樣做是為了分析一個國家的國際化技術模式的專利活動;在某個部門，技術或公司中申請專利活動，以確定或預測技術變革的方向，或確定公司在市場中的相對技術地位;因此，專利信息的使用已經擴展到國家，機構或企業層面的許多不同的戰術和戰略業務，研究和政策制定活動。因此，本課程的主要目標通過發表論文審查，重點關注幾個領域的專利信息分析。
description.en: In recent years, economists, social science researchers, policymakers, businessmen and professionals have begun to make increasing meso-level and macro-level use of patent information. This is being done to analyze, for example, patenting activities of a country' technical patterns of internationalization; patenting activities in a sector, technology or company to ascertain or forecast the direction of technical change, or ascertain the relative technological position of a company in a marketplace; etc. As such, the use of patent information has expanded to many different tactical and strategic business, research, and policy making activities at national, institutional or enterprise levels. Therefore, the primary objective of present course focus on patent information analysis in several areas through papers review.

name.zh: 專利資訊分析專題研究

description.zh: 公平交易法是經濟憲法，也是維持市場交易秩序的根本大法。當現代企業與市場的結構愈趨複雜，公平交易法的角色也愈顯重要。本課程將以案例分析，帶領學生了解公平交易法的基本原則。最後，本課程將規劃呈現科技發展下的新興壟斷議題，帶領學生一起探討。
description.en: The Fair Trade Act is often considered as the economic constitution also a set of fundamental rules to maintain the order of market. This Act is getting more and more important in the modern economy while the market is getting more and more chaotic and complicated. This course is designed for students who intend to understand the principles of the Fair Trade Act by case studies, and who is interested to learn about emerging technology monopoly issues.

description.zh: 人類在從事數學演算、推理交談、觀察等各類動作時，均展現出 "智慧"的現象。人工智慧即是利用電腦結合基本理論在有限度的範圍內從事上述各項工作，其中涵蓋了－自然語言了解、機器人學、電腦視覺、類神經網路、專家系統、自動化定理證明等，而本課程則主要在於提供必要之基礎，主要內容包括：1.搜尋法則，2. 命題與敘述邏輯，3. 定理證明，4. 知識系統與知識表達， 5. 機器學習， 6. 基因與演化計算，7. 智慧型代理人。

description.zh: 設計是造就其所處時代和文化下的產物。它是社會共有的價值觀體現，但設計的思考過程也用於代表特定的概念，鼓勵某些活動，從而影響社會和文化。本課程介紹現代和後現代設計的時代精神，涉及的重要發展包括建築、平面設計、產品設計、家具設計、室內設計、數字設計，甚至商業設計。本課程提供理解設計史上的精彩作品，透過政治、宗教、技術、文化、氣候和地理因素影響下的背景梳理。
description.en: Design is a product of the period and culture in which it is created. It is a representation of values shared by society but also used to represent specific ideals, encourage certain activities, and thus influence society and culture. This course provides an introduction to the zeitgeist of Modern and Postmodern Design. It deals with the most important developments including architecture, graphic design, product design, furniture design, interior design, digital design, and even business design. This course provides the background needed for understanding the rich heritage of historical design in the arts, as influenced by political, religious, technological, cultural, climatic and geographic factors.

description.en: This course is designed to cover the knowledge and skills required for sustainable industrial in the context of net-zero emissions. It will be taught in conjunction with the "Sustainable Engineer" certification exam of the Chinese Institute of Industrial Engineers. The course will explore the topics from both engineering and management perspectives, focusing on sustainable enterprise development. The management chapters will cover a range of areas such as climate change, sustainable finance, green supply chain, carbon-neutral strategies, climate-related financial disclosure, resource sustainability, and industrial symbiosis, as well as sustainable economic decision analysis. Meanwhile, the engineering chapters will delve into topics such as sustainable supply chain design, energy policies, carbon pricing, green product design and evaluation, green logistics, product-service systems, green smart production, circular economy, and clean production theories and case studies.

description.zh: 本課程旨在為學生提供創業和經營新創企業所需的基本知識和技能。 課程內容涵蓋當前各種形態的創業模式和創業家精神所具備的一些關鍵特質與必要的技能，學生將學習到如何識別市場機會並評估將想法商業化的可行性。本課程也將深入介紹行銷的核心概念與市場運作，包括市場細分，目標顧客定位和行銷組合，學生將學習到如何根據市場需求制定行銷策略並有效地實施。該課程還將涵蓋品牌策略、定價策略、推廣和銷售等主題。完成本課程後，學生將獲得關於創業以及經營企業的關鍵知識和技能，以及對行銷在創業過程中的作用有更深入的理解。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with the foundational knowledge and skills necessary to start and operate a new business venture. Students will learn about the various forms of entrepreneurship and entrepreneurship essentials, such as the characteristics, traits, and skills of successful entrepreneurs. Students will learn how to identify opportunities and assess the feasibility of a business idea. The course will then delve into the core concepts of marketing, including market segmentation, targeting, positioning, and the marketing mix. Students will learn how to develop a marketing plan and implement it effectively. The course will also cover topics such as branding, pricing strategies, promotion, and distribution. Upon completion of this course, students will have gained the knowledge and skills necessary to launch and operate a new business, as well as a deeper understanding of the role of marketing in entrepreneurship.

description.zh: 本課程介紹固體，尤其是半導體的光學性質，目的在了解光學檢測及光電元件的基礎原理。 藉由學習電磁波與半導體的交互作用，一方面可了解光在半導體中的產生、傳播、吸收、散射、及在界面的透射與反射等現象的規律，另一方面亦可認識光學特性與能帶結構、聲子結構、束縛與自由電子、及各種激發態之間的關係。課程內容包含固態物理複習、光學特性簡介、古典模型、帶間躍遷、激子、螢光現象、半導體低維系統的光學性質、自由載子及缺陷的光學性質、聲子相關特性、非線性光學性質等。

description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.en: This course aims to engage English major students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

description.en: This course examines important social, political, ethical, and aesthetic ideas in contemporary culture by examining a variety of audio-visual and written texts, including news articles, editorials, research papers, academic essays, videos, websites, movies, and stories. Students will practice observing and analyzing significant cultural phenomena in an effort to better understand how ideas, beliefs, and values develop and change over time, and are shaped by both longstanding traditions and by ever-changing popular trends.The course introduces fascinating cultural stories, events, issues, and trends to be studied, in order to develop students’ critical thinking, analytic skills, and cultural literacy.

In addition, the course is designed with the Problem-Based Learning (PBL) method, which includes group discussion and collaboration on working projects, corporate visit, and project presentation, etc., so that students' capabilities of creativity and innovation can be developed or enhanced.

However, due to the vast number of literary works and limited course time, it is not possible to introduce literary works in a chronological or historical manner. Therefore, in order to avoid overly general or shallow content, this course will be taught thematically. That is, students will be guided from depth to breadth by literary genres, time periods, authors, or styles, gradually cultivating their ability to appreciate literature.

description.zh: ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
description.en: The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

description.zh: 本課程探討太空任務的設計和實施，以實現太空任務目標。本課程涵蓋，太空任務的目標、設計流程、系統工程原理、燃料和動力系統、通訊和導航系統、太空運輸系統、生命維持系統、太空裝備和儀器、以及太空任務的管理和財務考慮因素。
description.en: This course discusses the design and implementation of space missions to achieve their goals. The course covers the goals of space missions, design processes, principles of systems engineering, fuel and propulsion systems, communication and navigation systems, space transportation systems, life support systems, space equipment and instruments, as well as management and financial considerations for space missions.

description.zh: 系統工程是一個專注於複雜系統設計、開發和管理的工程領域，通常涉及許多不同類型的元件。 系統工程結合了幾個不同領域的方面，包括機械工程、電氣工程、工業工程、生產工程、化學工程和電腦科學，以分析、設計和管理複雜的系統。 系統工程工作的例子可能包括分析流程和生產週期、最佳化製造或分銷系統，以及開發系統模型或改進現有系統等項目。本課程將包含：基礎系統工程概論、專案生命週期、系統設計流程、產品實現、技術管理等部分。
description.en: Systems engineering is a field of engineering that focuses on the design, development, and management of complex systems, often involving many different types of components. Systems engineering combines aspects of several different fields, including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, production engineering, chemical engineering, and computer science, to analyze, design, and manage complex systems. This course will include an introduction to system engineering, project life cycle, system design process, product realization, technical management.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為使學生以電子學的知識，應用在生物醫學的臨床領域，包含擷取人體的生理參數或用以治療人類疾病。本課程將介紹醫電系統與電子電路的原理，進而介紹生理測量的應用電路，由電路的實現使學生更能感受到生醫電子的實際應用範疇。主要講解醫療儀器之技術原理與應用，其中包含測量理論、生醫感測器、電極與換能器、生醫電子放大器、血壓和心血管診斷儀器、呼吸治療與肺功能測量、腦神經系統之功能測量與治療，電磁波對醫療電子設備的干擾，以及醫療設備之電氣安全進行說明與探討。本課程主要著重在觀念的溝通與臨床之應用，而非公式的演釋與計算，使學生能學習與扮演電子工程與臨床醫學之橋樑角色。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with electronics knowledge, to help the clinical application in the biomedical field, including capture the body's physiological parameters or for the treatment of human diseases. This course will introduce the medical electronic systems and electronic circuit theory, and then introduce the application of physiological measurement circuit. The circuit implementation so that students can experience the practical application of biomedical electronics category. Mainly on medical equipment and application of technical principles, which include measurement theory, biomedical sensors, electrodes and transducers, biomedical electronic amplifier, blood pressure and cardiovascular diagnostic equipment, respiratory therapy and pulmonary function measurement, brain and nerve system function measurement and treatment, electromagnetic interference with medical electronic equipment, and medical equipment electrical safety instructions and discussion. This course

description.zh: 本課程旨在經由對文化經濟學的認知，解讀文化經濟的發展邏輯與運行機制，建構文化經濟知識體系，期能為文化市場與文化產業發展提供理論基礎與思維座標。課程主要內容，一為在經濟邏輯運行下的文化活動，諸如文化產品、文化事業、文化資本、文化產業、文化市場等；另一為經濟活動所反映與體現的文化因素，以及對經濟運行產生作用的思維價值等。
description.en: The course aims through awareness of cultural economics to interpret the development logic and operating mechanism of cultural economy and to construct a cultural economic knowledge system, and is expected to provide the theoretical basis and thinking coordinates for the development of cultural markets and cultural industries.The main content of the course is economic logics underpinned cultural activities, such as cultural products, cultural business, cultural capital, cultural industries and cultural markets; on the other hand, cultural factors reflected and experienced by economic activities, as well as the value of thinking which plays an important role in economic activities.

description.en: This course is intended to introduce the concepts, principles, and standards for effective R&D/innovation management that is becoming the critical competitive advantages for the knowledge-intensive organizations and firms. The course will introduce a number of related cases and exercises with a view to bridge the national, industrial and corporate R&D/innovation activities, along with the presentation of selected approaches, methods and tools to effectively integrate functional, business and corporate R&D and innovation activities as a whole.

This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.en: Use Python 3 to lead students to understand the following topics, the difficulty has been adjusted, and it is suitable for students with zero foundation or non-information related subjects to learn:Data Processing / Deep Learning / Machine Vision.

name.en: AI, machine vision and Deep learning

notes: 需自備筆電， 建議具備Python基礎程式能力

description.zh: 遊戲化是一種能有效提升產品服務體驗的設計手段。本課程首先介紹遊戲化和行為設計的理論基礎，並透過參與式設計工作坊，結合遊戲機制於產品系統創新的開發過程。
description.en: Gamification is a technique that can stimulate users’ motivation and engagement in various non-game contexts such as education, business, health, workplace, and so on. This course is divided into two parts. The first part provides the theoretical background, consisting of the gamification definition/taxonomy, and behavioral design. In the second part of this course, students will organize a participatory design workshop to gain insights from the stakeholders to develop delightful products and services based on game mechanics.

notes: 工設三四合開；上限13人

description.zh: 本課程的目的在於讓同學們瞭解經營績效評估的方法，強調理論與實作並重。首先會介紹資料包絡分析法(DEA)的基本概念，讓同學們對於DEA理論有基本的瞭解，接下來再讓同學們學習如何使用電腦套裝軟體進行實際運算，並探討各種企業經營效率分析上的應用。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to let students understand the methods of business performance evaluation, emphasizing both theory and practice. Firstly, this course will introduce the basic concept of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) so that students can understand DEA theory. Then students will learn how to use computer-packaged software for actual calculations and discuss the application of various business efficiency analyses.

name.zh: 企業經營效率分析實作
name.en: Implementation of Business Operation Efficiency Analysis

description.zh: 根據 Kaggle Survey2020（全球資料科學家調查），SQL在資料科學家使用的程式語言中，排名第二，僅次於 Python。SQL 是用來查詢與操作資料庫的語言，是數據分析與商業智能的重要工具。本課程以mySQL資料庫為對象，來學習關聯式資料庫的操作與各種SQL語法，它是整體商業智能分析體系的重要技術。在現代商業智慧領域，經常利用SQL資料庫、雲平臺和機器學習等新技術，將資料轉換為有用的見解，提出解決方案以改進企業決策，其應用包括零售葉在內的各種經營管理領域。本課程將幫助同學具有SQL分析數據的能力，此將有助於後續做好商情預測，提出改善方案以輔助企業能抓住市場脈動，進而分析消費者的需求。
description.en: According to Kaggle Survey2020, SQL ranks second among the programming languages used by data scientists, second only to Python. SQL is a language used to query and operate databases, and is an important tool for data analysis and business intelligence. This course takes the mySQL database as the object to learn the operation of the relational database and various SQL syntax, which is an important technology of the overall business intelligence analysis system. In the field of modern business intelligence, new technologies such as SQL databases, cloud platforms, and machine learning are often used to convert data into useful insights and propose solutions to improve corporate decision-making. It is applied to various business management fields including retail leaflets. This course will help students have the ability to analyze data with SQL, which will help to make good business forecasts in the future, propose improvement plans to assist enterprises to grasp the pulse of the market,

name.en: MySQL for Data Analytics and Business Intelligence

notes: 經管三四和經管所合開

description.zh: 建立一個商務網站包括前端網頁與後端伺服器網頁，本課程將介紹前端網頁設計的方法，包括CSS,HTML,JavaScript。網頁的基本框架是Html標籤語法，網頁的樣式設計是CSS的樣式設計，網頁的互動效果是透過JavaScript程式來達成的。由於JavaScript容易理解的特性，史丹佛大學已經將JavaScript取代Java，成為程式設計的入門教材 本課程也會介紹目前網頁的主流：響應性網頁RWD(bootstrap)的設計方法。
description.en: Building a business website includes front-end web pages and back-end server web pages. This course will introduce the methods of front-end web page design, including CSS, HTML, and JavaScript. The basic framework of a webpage is the syntax of Html tags, the style design of the webpage is the style design of CSS, and the interactive effect of the webpage is achieved through JavaScript programs. This course will also introduce the current mainstream of web pages: the design method of responsive web RWD (bootstrap).

description.zh: 本課程將介紹人工智慧在各種商情預測的技應用，做好商情預測有利於確保企業發展方向的正確性，也能讓企業更能抓住市場脈動而滿足消費者的需求不會造成太多的庫存堆積，保持市場供需的動態平衡。本課程規劃所欲培育人才所需之教學目標包括：（1）學生有能力使用python寫各種商業智能程式，包括使用pandas模組裡進行商業數據分析與視覺化。使用numpy，sklearn機器學習模組來處理迴歸分析問題。使用keras模組來進行深度學習的商業預測應用。（2）實作多種商情預測專題。
description.en: This course will introduce the technological application of artificial intelligence in various business forecasts to help students understand the current status of various applications of AI in business forecasts.The teaching objectives required for cultivating talents in this course planning include:(1) Students are able to use python to write various business intelligence programs, including using pandas modules for business data analysis and visualization. Use numpy, sklearn machine learning module to handle regression analysis problems. Use keras modules for business forecasting applications of deep learning.(2) Implement a variety of business forecast topics.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域商情預測之應用
name.en: The Application of Artificial Intelligence on Business Forecasting

interdisciplinary: 人工智慧賦能跨域應用微學程

description.zh: 透過我國金融體系與相關金融證券交易法規之概述，促使學生瞭解銀行法、證券交易法、信託法與信託業法、金融機構合併法、金融監理一元化等法規之性質、內容、立法目的及原則，進而培養學生明瞭本國有價證券之發行程序、證券交易市場以及證券交易法之責任規範等立法精神與體制，俾能達到融會貫通的境界並因應未來金融市場之競爭與挑戰。
description.en: The objectives of this course are trying to explain Taiwan's financial system and Financial and Securities Exchange Act, to help students recognize the Banking Act, the Securities and Exchange Law, Trust Law and Trust Business Law, Financial Institutions Merger Act, the financial supervision unification. In addition, the nature, content, lawmaking objectives and principles of related legislation will be introduced. The goals of this course will further promote students to understand the procedures for issuing securities, the spirit, responsibility and institutional norms of securities market and the Securities Exchange Act, so that to achieve the state of digest, in response to market competition and financial challenges in the future.

notes: 經管三四合開

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹專業英文論文的寫作格式，以及文件編修的技巧，且用深入淺出的例子作為示範，並輔以實際寫作練習與錯誤訂正。學員學習研究論文組織寫作﹐包含修改本身論文結構之基本技巧﹐正確組織文章的各個片段﹐避免口語用字寫字的陋習﹐使所作之文章能掌握其涵意﹐亦即能更有效率的利用英文寫出科技論文之佳作。
description.en: The goal of English Technical Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.

notes: 土木201/博士班必修

description.zh: 以演講，討論，口頭及書面報告方式，探討土木與防災之相關課題，如結構檢測評估與補強，水土防災技術，防災體系與資訊，都市防災，消防防災，施工災變，環境防災規劃與管理等。
description.en: By means of addresses discussion, oral presentations and reports to learn and investigate the related civil and disaster prevention subjects, such as structure testing, evaluation and repairing, soil and water disaster prevention, urban precaution, fire fighting, construction safety, environmental planning, and management for disaster prevention.

notes: 博士班

description.zh: 研究生在教授之個別指導下，針對特定研究主題進行研究，並將研究成果寫成論文。
description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor. The results should be written as a thesis.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓同學學習智慧顯示與感測相關的理論與瞭解相關產業動向，除了透過相關產業導師的教導與實地工廠的參訪，讓同學在最短的時間內對台灣智慧顯示與感測有初步的認識，此外，本課程也包含各種液晶元件的實作與其相關光電特性的量測與應用，讓同學能將理論與實務合而為一。
description.en: The main goal of this course is to teach students the theories and related industrial trends of intelligent displays and sensors. This will be achieved through lectures by industry experts and visits to factories, allowing students to gain a basic understanding of the relevant industries in Taiwan within a short period of time. The course will also include hands-on projects focusing on various LCD components and related optoelectronic properties measurement and application. By combining theory and practice, students can gain a comprehensive understanding of intelligent displays and sensors.

name.zh: 智慧顯示與感測含實習(I)
name.en: Intelligent display and sensing with internship (I)

notes: 光電三四合開

description.zh: 在科技發展快速的年代，有些人認為產業和市場需要更多新的法律規範，也有些人認為舊有法律需要鬆綁。但無庸置疑地，法律在科技、產業與市場的發展中，扮演著一個攸關重要的角色。基於此，本課程嘗試以設計案例討論，鼓勵不同背景的學生，經由案例分析得到綜合性的知識、從中了解科技發展如何影響法律變遷，並進而學習專業的法律策略。
description.en: In an age of rapid technology advancement, some people might insist more laws are necessary to regulate the industry and the market, on the contrary, others might think de-regulation is the best approach to encourage the free flow of the market. Nonetheless, it is beyond question that law and regulations play an vital role in the technology-driven economy today. Therefore this course is designed to help students from various backgrounds to engage in the group discussions on assigned cases. Students are expected to learn how the technology development shapes the legal environment and learn how to analyze the legal strategies.

name.zh: 科技發展與法律策略：案例研析
name.en: Technology Development and Legal Strategy: Case Study

notes: 日職合開

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在介紹太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，並探討太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The Space Technology Application Course aims to introduce the application of space technology in various fields, and explore how space technology impacts human life and scientific research. The course covers topics including space exploration, Earth observation, communication and satellite navigation, space engineering and materials science, space biology and medicine, and space economy and business. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the application of space technology in various fields and future development directions, and be able to master relevant technologies and knowledge.

notes: 太空所新聘老師合授

description.zh: 本課程將從不同的金融服務領域應用幫助同學瞭解數位金融的發展以及生成式AI於金融科技之應用。本課程之教學目標包括：(1) 人工智慧跨域應用金融產品企劃與數位行銷：掌握虛擬通路與實體通路的差異與整合應用，導入通用式人工智慧搭配合適的使用者介面與體驗設計；(2) 智慧金融科技素養與創新應用：關注大數據、雲端運算、物聯網與人工智慧的各種創新應用，並了解機器學習於資金管理之應用與人工智慧於量化交易之應用；(3) 生成式AI導入與開發：透過課程整合微軟Azure Open AI雲端服務資源，讓學生具有導入ChatGPT及聊天機器人開發能力，並連結創新創業課程建立明確創業目標，導入跨領域創業課程，養成專業職能和研發實力，進而了解金融產業在數位轉型中，所面臨的困難與挑戰。
description.en: 英文概述English Description This course will help students understand the development of digital finance and the application of generative AI in financial technology from different financial service applications. The objectives of this program include: (1) Financial product planning and digital marketing; (2) Intelligent financial technology literacy and innovative applications; (3) Generative AI Introduction and Development: Integrate Microsoft Azure Open AI cloud service resources through the course to provide students with the ability to introduce ChatGPT and chat robot development, and link to innovative entrepreneurship courses to establish clear entrepreneurial goals and introduce cross-disciplinary entrepreneurship courses to develop professional functions and R&D capabilities.

name.zh: 人工智慧跨域金融之應用

interdisciplinary: 人工智慧賦能跨域應用微學程
notes: 資財三四甲乙合開

description.zh: 臺灣島位於西太平洋，就板塊構造運動而言，臺灣上新－更新世的造山運動代表歐亞大陸板塊的前緣和其東側以西北方向前進的菲律賓海洋板塊間的衝撞聚合運動。東臺灣花蓮和臺東間的縱谷，已被認為是兩個板塊間的縫合帶和板塊聚合的邊緣。在臺灣的北部，大陸和島弧的碰撞型式可能是菲律賓海板塊向北傾沒到位於歐亞大陸板塊上的琉球島弧系統之下。但是向南沿東臺灣縱谷，在北緯二十四度以南，板塊隱沒方向發生改變，歐亞大陸板塊於此向東隱沒進入菲律賓海板塊之下。此一特殊的板塊背景造就了臺灣多樣的地質現象‧本課程之內容主要探討台灣地區(包括海域)自中生代至現代的大地構造演變及其地體構造運動、盆地演化、岩石圈的結構及性質、造山運動機制等各種地質現象。希望能藉由瞭解臺灣區域地質，從而作為探討臺灣地質工程與環境領域之基礎‧
description.en: Taiwan island is located on the weastern Pacific Ocean. The plate tectonic setting of Taiwan is the convergence and collision between the western Eurasian plate and the easterly impinging Philippine Sea plate on the Pli-Pleistocene. The Longitudinal Valley between Hualien and Taitung in eastern Taiwan has been recognized as the suture zone between these two plates. In northeastern Taiwan, convergence is marked by northward subduction of the Philippine Sea plate beneath the Ryukyu Arc System on the Eurasian plate along the Ryukyu Trench. The subduction polarity changes at 24°N near Hualien in eastern Taiwan. There plate convergence is marked by eastward subduction of the Eurasian plate underneath the Luzon Arc System on the Philippine Sea plate along the Eastern Longitudinal Valley. name.en: Special Topics on Regional Geology of Taiwan

notes: 大研合開

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹資料探勘與大數據分析的理論方法與應用，課程內容涵蓋資料探勘的基本概念，如資料準備、資料探勘的方法與實證、資料探勘的進一步運用，並加入商業等各領域的實務案例介紹，具體說明如何應用資料探勘與大數據分析技術以解決真實問題。另外在工具方面則透過相關分析軟體操作與實作範例輔以說明，讓學生學習資料的準備、工具的應用及分析判斷，透過實作課程，使學生能容易應用資料探勘方法，進而提升大數據分析和數位決策能力。
description.en: This course explores the rapidly developing fields of big data for the efficiency of decision making in various fields. The topics are about basic concepts of data manipulations, analytic, and communications which are including: introduction to big data; basic knowledge of data mining; special topics of big data in business Analytics, and data analytic project.The course will help students careful consideration of what is desired from big data, how big data analytic to add value to business, etc.Students can gain a strong data science knowledge set and techniques via in-depth case studies, most current readings and experiences, and most current and future technology exploration.

notes: 計中電腦教室；資財四甲乙和資財所、IMBA、電資資安、

description.zh: 政策研究能檢視理論和實務的切合程度。本課程將帶領大家認識環境政策的經濟分析方法，學習經濟的思維觀點，以及如何運用經濟方法瞭解解決環境問題。除此之外上課內容並與法律結合，探討環境法的經濟分析觀點和傳統思維有何不同，尤其是對環境行為上之改變效果。希望學生能夠具體瞭解經濟分析方法幫助政府解決環境問題及規劃環境政策時所扮演的角色。
description.en: There is a significant trade-off between economic growth and environmental quality. From this course, students will learn fundamental concepts in Environmental Economics and how to analyze environmental policy issues by using economic tools. In additions, this course combines economic analysis to law, especially shows students how regulations affect people's behavior. After this class, students not only know how economic approaches help the government deal with environmental issues and the differences between theory and practices.

name.en: Environmental Economics and Environmental Policies Analysis

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters. The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis. After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

Topics include socialization and education, social change transition and education, equity of educational opportunity, collaboration between social development and technical-vocational education, etc.

description.zh: 物聯網系統包含了感測器與感測網路，邊緣閘道，雲端服務與存取裝置，可建構眾多的端到端商業應用包含無人商店與智慧支付的場景金融，遠距醫療與照護，智慧製造與智慧家庭等。本課程將教授物聯網系統的設計包含裝置與服務的技術，並以各項商業應用場景做課題的探討。
description.en: The Internet of Things (IoT) system encompasses sensors and sensor networks, IoT gateways, cloud services, and mobile devices, enabling the development of numerous end-to-end business applications, including scenarios such as unmanned stores, and intelligent payment in the financial sector, remote healthcare and caregiving, smart manufacturing, and smart homes. This course will teach the design of IoT systems, including device and service technologies, and explore various business application scenarios as topics of discussion.

name.zh: 物聯網系統設計與商業應用
name.en: IoT System design and Business Application

description.zh: 「新興支付應用暨產業發展」是一門探討現今支付產業趨勢的課程，課程內容包括了第三方電子支付、行動支付、跨領域支付應用、先買後付（Buy Now Pay Later, BNPL）及加密貨幣支付等。同時課程也會探討其產業發展脈絡、業者策略及監管等相關議題
description.en: This course explores current payment industry trends. The course content includes third-party electronic payments, mobile payments, cross-domain payment applications, Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), and encrypted currency payments. At the same time, the course will also explore related issues such as industry development context, operator strategies, and regulation.

description.zh: 本課程在使學生了解各種不同的資訊科技(Information Technology)與管理資訊系統間的關連性，並結合金融企業導入產業議題，實際應用所教授的IT技術進行學術研究。藉由IT技術的應用演練，讓學生將實際進行問題分析、模型發展、系統開發、模擬實驗及最後的研究結論與模型驗證。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。
description.en: This course is to enable students to understand the relationship between various Information Technology and management information systems, and cooperate with financial companies to introduce industrial topics, and actually apply the IT technology taught for academic research. Through the application and exercise of IT technology, students will actually carry out problem analysis, model development, system development, and simulation experiments. At last, students can summarize research conclusions and model validation. Thus, students can improve their independent thinking and problem-solving ability, and further cultivate their scientific attitude and academic research knowledge.

description.en: This curriculum lets students understand how to choose and use multi-variance statistics methods exactly. It also includes that reading, presenting and explaining the report or result of multi-variance statistics analysis exactly. The topics of the curriculum include that factor design, experimental design, covariance analysis, and multi-regression, al etc. to explore the influence of multi and simultaneous factors in the educational research.

notes: 博班

description.zh: 超快雷射由於其脈衝寬度在皮秒(10-12)之下，它在軍事科技、工業應用、生醫檢測與學術研究所扮演的角色日益重要，本課程將介紹超短脈衝雷射的種類，尤其著重在光纖短脈衝雷產生的原理、脈衝壓縮的技術與超短脈衝寬度與相位量測的技術，此外也將介紹超快雷射的各種應用包括光譜量測、泵-探量測與非線性光學量測等技術。
description.en: Due to relative short pulse below one picosecond, ultrafast lasers have been widely used in various fields including military, industry, biomedical diagnosis and scientific research. In this course, it will introduce various kinds of the ultrafast lases, especially on the principle of mode-locked fiber generation, pulse compression technique and the method of the ultrashort pulsewidth measurement as well as phase retrieval. Various applications of ultrafast laser including fluorescence, pump-probe and nonlinear optical measurement have also been introduced in this course.

notes: 太空所新聘

description.zh: 課程主要為介紹學術界最新的深度學習研究成果，教導學員使用Python深度學習套件，讓學員能將深度學習技術應用於各個不同的領域。課程內容包括：車牌與門牌數字辨識、人臉辨識、1000種影像分類、辨識9000種物件、自動駕駛模擬、嵌入式深度學習演算法。空虛, 寂寞, 覺得冷? 讓深度學習來幫助你:遞迴式神經網路(RNN)：找不到人聊天？訓練自己的聊天機器人、對抗生成網路(GAN)：用GAN產生自己的夢中情人、深度強化學習(DRL)：訓練AI跟你一起玩遊戲。
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce latest deep learning researches and allow students to develop deep learning applications using Python library (TensorFlow & Keras). The content includes: Number recognition of License plate and Doorplate、Face Recognition 、1000 Image Classification 、9000 Object Detection、Autopilot simulation 、Embedded Deep Learning Algorithms 、Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) 、Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) 、Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) 、Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN)、Deep Reinforcement Learning.

name.zh: 深度學習應用開發實務

notes: 電子所和電資外生大研合開

description.en: 1. To familiarize students with fuzzy logic and fuzzy inference. 2. To familiarize students with designing controllers based on fuzzy inference. 3. To familiarize students with system modeling through fuzzy rules.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電腦科學中圖形識別的基本原理與相關技術，使學生了解各種圖形識別的分類方法，經由對分類問題的分析，瞭解如何將輸入樣本依不同特性加以分類，並熟悉圖形識別系統之相關議題如：分割、特徵擷取、分類、後處理、訓練、監督/非監督式學習、機器學習，進而了解分類問題，增進其解決實際圖形識別分類問題的能力。課程內容包括下列課題：圖形識別概論, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood, 非參數法學習, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Positive Boolean Function多分類器, Linear Discriminant Functions，高維資料分類, 分類正確率評估(Accuracy Assessments)及其他重要的應用，例如: 文件分析、生物辨識、影像監控、遙測影像分類、醫療診斷、資料探勘等概念，最後並透過相關論文的研讀及討論，了解近代圖形識別的最新發展趨勢。
description.en: The course includes: Introduction to Pattern Recognition, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood & Bayesian Parameter Estimation, Non-Parametric Classification - Density Estimation, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Multi-Classifier - Positive Boolean Function, Linear Discriminant Functions, Pattern Recognition of High Dimensional Data Sets, Pattern Recognition for Remote Sensing Images, Biometric Certification, Video Surveillance, Accuracy Assessments and Other Related Topics.

notes: 電機所和電資AI、創新AI和電資外生所合開

description.zh: 人類從尚未有文字的歷史以來，就有各種不同規模的戰爭，戰爭很吊詭的以你死或我亡，相互毀滅之態勢，爭奪「活著」的條件。古今中外，爆發戰爭的因素或為爭奪領土、權位、或為族群之戰、為意識形態之戰、或為物質資源之爭奪。在視覺影像發達的今日社會，有關戰爭的歷史影像的紀錄片與劇情片數量龐大、並有許多可觀之處。本課程將利用這些描寫戰爭影像資料，帶領同學瞭解相關戰爭與戰役爆發的歷史及其經過。
description.en: Throughout human history, even prior to written record, various types of warfare and scales of battles have existed for various purposes of domination or survival by all means of cruelty and destruction. The arousal of violent conflicts might be an attempt at fighting for territorial dominion or material resources economically or altering another species ideologically. In today's modern societies, bountiful documentaries and films concerning historical warfare have been accumulated. This course will aim at giving students a broad understanding and profound knowledge of the causes, process, and effects of significant warfare in human history with the aid of visual images in different media.

notes: 106-108：歷史與文化選修。109(含)後：人文與藝術

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

notes: 106-108：美學與藝術核心。109(含)後：人文與藝術

description.zh: 本課程目標如下：（一）以心理學為基礎，探討人類生活各面向的知識；（二）建立學生生活行為的技能；（三）促使學生建立自己積極的價值體系。 本課程內容涵蓋人類的個體發展、學習方式、動機、情緒、態度、人格、兩性、愛情、家庭、育兒、健康管理、社會行為等生活面的相關行為。 本課程採學生中心教學法，以啟發法、小組討論、創造式發表等方式授課，藉以活潑學生的思考並增加學生上台練習的機會。
description.en: The objectives of this course are : (1)By basing on the psychology to guide our students to discuss the variant facets of their lives. (2)To establish the students' good skills to deal with their own lives. (3)To found the students' positive value systems . This course includes the human behaviors of individual development , learning strategies, motivations, emotion, attitudes, personality, social interaction, religious lives, love, bisexual interaction, family lives, children cultivation , and etc. This course uses the learner-centered instructing strategies. The methods of discovery learning, teams discussion, creative teaching , and etc. will be adopted, in order to excite the students to do deep thought and give them the opportunities to show their efforts and achievements themselves.

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學選修。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 經濟學重視邏輯與嚴謹推理的理性特質是其主要特色，此亦為理工科系人之專長優勢，然而僅偏重左腦訓練的人才往往讓人覺得生冷機械，對事物看法也常過於直接而缺乏人情，若能在不失理性效率之下，兼顧以人為本之社會人文感性關懷，則經濟學自無愧為社會科學之母，其訓練目標亦與通識教育的人格均衡發展目的一致！為避免陷入一般經濟教學因理論工具比重過高而失焦，導致學生學習興趣驟減以致成效不彰，本課程重點在於先讓學生擁有強烈之學習動機，接著認知到"確立學習目的"的重要性，藉由生活實例直接帶領學生面對並感受問題，從而引導出經濟學切入問題的思維方式，並傳授其正確可行的學習態度與方法，同時提醒學生維持對專業知識批判的精神，在嚴謹訓練架構下督促其尋求感性的意涵，因而不致陷入經濟工具與名詞的浩瀚泥沼中，從而漸進體會出經濟學之精髓。
description.en: The science of economics is characterized by logics and cautious reasoning-at which most of the students of natural science and technology are good at. It is also a fact that those who take better advantage of the right brain are very likely to be straightforward and thus seemingly more mechanical and unsympathetic. Economics can be seen as the mother of science under the condition that rational efficiency-as well as the socially humanity--are kept at the same time. As a matter of act, the economic trainings share the same goal as what is required by the General Education courses.The first priority of the course is to highly motivate the students in the economic issues. We do our best to avoid too much weight generally put into teaching economics, leading to poor learning and teaching experience. Cases are studied in such a way that students will recognize the "real purpose of studying." Real cases and examples are brought into discussion. We guide the students to"feel"the problems.

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學核心。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 此門課程主要在於瞭解社會學的意涵，並藉由跨領域的學習，讓不同學科能有對話的空間。課程涵蓋的範圍會兼顧理論與實用性，讓學生能思考當今的社會，理解到產生因素的多元性，並進而使個人眼界能更加開拓。期望學生於課程學習中能夠擁有更多對於整個社會的不同思維，以強化本身學科之所需，不但具有理論性深入的洞察力，也能引用到管理上實質的層面。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to understand sociology. It covers theory and practicability, and make students consider the current society, and understand the generated factors of diversity . Expect students' study can have more for the community as a whole different way of thinking, in order to strengthen their academic needs, not only has the theoretical depth of insight, but also on the substance applied to the management level.

interdisciplinary: 文化永續與社會創新-社會實踐微學程
notes: 106-108：社會與哲學核心。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 現代科技文明進展得非常迅速，這使得一般人日常生活中，可能經常享受到這些科技所帶來的便利，但卻習以為常，以為天生下來就是這樣的，這些現代的科技，可能是關於電機的、物理的、化工的、光電的、材料的......，更有可能同時涉及了其他許多個領域，更可能有許多人希望能夠了解這些科技的來龍去脈，一窺其究竟，人類在沒有土木工程學之前，早已能建築萬里長城和金字塔，許許多多的科技是由嘗試錯誤，經驗的累積逐漸得來的，當然，隨著知識的不斷窮究其理，"知而後行"的高科技也就會越來越多，我們在這裡也試圖去追蹤各項科技的演進史與現況方面讓大家知道羅馬不是一天所造成的，另一方面也讓大家有從另一個角度重新思考的機會，也許這些科技進化到現在，還稱不上成熟的階段，您也許可以找出另一種更好的方法來改進它們！
description.en: Modern technology is growing fast. People thus enjoy the convenience in company with the technology—which they do and they just take it for granted to do. It may have something to do with electrical engineering, physics, chemical engineering, electro-optical engineering, materials…Some problems involves more than one field. People are curious about the technology and willing to know how to solve the problems. Human beings are able to build the pyramids and the Long Walls before they know anything about civil engineering—knowledge actually piled up by trial and error or accumulated experience. As knowledge expands, hi-end technology which requires “know-how” becomes more popular. In this course, we try to trace the history and the current situations: “Rome was not built in a day.” On the other hand, we might take another chance to RE-think a deeper problem: technology evolves without getting to maturity. Human beings will be enforced to find some other ways to improve it.

notes: 106-108：自然與科學選修。109(含)後：自然與科學

description.zh: 本課程名稱為 “環境與自然保育” 。它包括二大範疇：(1)自然環境和自然資源的保育，(2)自然環境的保存、維護、利用、復原及改良。它將教導學生下列主題：自然保育的基本概念（自然保育的定義、自然保育觀念的發展）、保育生物學（物種形成和滅絕、生物多樣性、物種保護的優先原則、生物入侵）、生態經濟學簡介（生態經濟學的原則、能量流與物質流分析）、自然保護區（自然保護區之概念、自然保護區的保護對象）、自然保育政策（國際自然保育策略、台灣的自然保育機構及相關法規）與自然保育運動（自然保育運動之發展、當前自然保育運動所關心的事）。整體而言, 本課程期盼提升公民生態意識和環境覺知, 使大家對環境保育做出更多貢獻。
description.en: The title of this course is “Environment and Nature Conservation”. It includes two categories: (1) conservation of the natural environment and natural resources, and (2) the preservation, maintenance, restoration and improvement of the natural environment. It will introduce to students the following themes: basic concepts of nature conservation, conservation biology, introduction to ecological economics, nature reservation, nature conservation policy, and nature conservation movement. As a whole, it aims to raise our citizens’ ecological consciousness and environmental awareness and thus enable them to make more contribution to the conservation of our environment.

notes: 106-108：自然與科學選修。109(含)後：自然與科學

description.zh: 學習相似於Microsoft Power Point 的「拖-拉-點-選」操作方式，再加上一小部份的 Low Code程式編碼，即可以設計與製作出:「專業級的 APP」 !本課程運用學校內的雲端平台: AgilePoint NX，改變了以往撰寫APP 的模式，不再需要撰寫複雜的程式碼，讓學生專注於 APP的邏輯流程與UI(使用者介面)，進而發展貼近市場裡的商業模式，設計出精彩的APP!課程的教學，採用傳統臺北工專的黑手工程師訓練模式:「由經入史」:先講解理論架構，進而延伸到產業的實務運用。嚴格要求上課同學動手實做，達成每週的設定目標。課堂上講師所示範的範例非常豐富，下課後會有一定份量的Homework(實作型作業)。經此系統化訓練，在APP的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。「讓不懂IT(資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的APP! 」
description.en: Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

name.en: Start to APP Design and Application

notes: 106-108：創新與創業選修。109(含)後：創新與創業

description.zh: 雲端(Cloud)與物聯網(Internet of Things, IoT)重塑了整個計算世界對於事物的運行方式。除了為各行業提出了新的前沿應用外，也衍生更多在兩者融合對於管理、資訊安全與隱私保護等不得不重視的課題。本課程主要討論雲端與物聯網相關的安全性問題，包括由物聯網衍生出來的新威脅、弱點及兩者融合的相關安全議題。引領學生具備發展雲端與物聯網安全的重要觀念與技術，進而可以分析、設計與規劃未來物聯網與雲端運算融合之應用、與安全管理。
description.en: Cloud and the Internet of Things (IoT) have reshaped the way things are performed across the computing world. In addition to proposing new cutting-edge applications for various industries, there are also more issues that must be paid attention to in the integration of the two, such as management, information security and privacy protection. This course mainly discusses the security issues related to cloud and the IoT, including new threats and weaknesses derived when the two technologies converge. To lead students to understand important concepts and technologies for cloud and IoT security, and then to able to analyze, design, plan application and implement security management of the integration of the cloud and IoT.

notes: 資財三四甲乙和資財所、電資資安和創新資安合開

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

notes: 106-108：美學與藝術選修。109(含)後：人文與藝術

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

notes: 106-108：美學與藝術核心。109(含)後：人文與藝術

description.zh: 近代以降，由於戰爭的影響，臺灣歷經不同的政權和政體，諸如大清帝國、日本帝國及中華民國等。國際局勢、殖民統治、捍衛國土等緣由引發各式各樣的戰爭，戰爭促進臺灣的政治、社會、經濟、文化等層面的變革。因此以戰爭為主軸，認知臺灣在世界地緣位置的重要性，及其引起的各種戰爭類型，呈現戰爭在近現代臺灣各時期的各種風貌。臺灣是個位於西太平洋海陸交接地區的島嶼，在世界局勢變動的潮流之中，塑造其特有的戰爭型式及內涵。再者，臺灣各地有諸多戰爭遺址，不乏國定古蹟，可以藉由戰爭史的脈絡得知戰爭遺址的歷史空間及其文化資產的重要性。
description.en: Since modern times, due to the influence of wars, Taiwan has experienced different regimes and political systems, such as the Qing Empire, the Japanese Empire, and the Republic of China. The international situation, colonial rule, and defense of the country have triggered various wars. Wars have promoted changes in Taiwan’s politics, society, economy, and culture. Therefore, taking war as the main core, understanding the importance of Taiwan's geopolitics in the world, and the types of wars it caused, presents the various features of wars. Taiwan is an island located in the land-sea junction of the Western Pacific Ocean. In the changing tide of the world situation, Taiwan has shaped its unique war style and connotation. Furthermore, there are many military relics throughout Taiwan, and there are many national historical sites. Students can learn about the historical space of military relics and the importance of their cultural assets through the context of war history.

notes: 106-108：歷史與文化選修。109(含)後：人文與藝術

description.zh: 大眾傳播與人類社會的關係，正隨科技的進步而日益擴大它的影響力。根據學者研究發現，人類的思想、態度與價值觀念受大眾傳播的影響日漸加深，大傳媒介不但塑造人的思想，同時也影響人們的行為及價值；然而從傳播的功能言，大眾傳播同時具有正面與負面的社會功能，故大眾傳播的發展與過程，殊值重視與探討。本課程兼顧理論與實例的探討，包括傳播特性與要素、大眾傳播的能及效果、新聞守門人理論等，並以實例分析新聞的公正客觀性、新聞自由與國家安全、媒體與選舉等傳播爭議性問題。修習本課程可培養學生閱讀新聞的正確性，不玫人云亦云，受媒體報導所擺佈；同時亦可增強學生人際溝通的技巧與能力。
description.en: With the advancement of technology, mass communication is enlarging its influence in human society. According to researches, the thoughts, attitudes and value judgements of humans are deeply affected by mass communication. The media not only shape persons' thoughts, but also have an impact on their behavior and values. Since mass communication has positive and negative social functions at the same time, its development and process are therefore worthy of paying much attention and exploration to us. This course includes the study of the theory and practice of mass communication, such as characteristics and elements functions and effects, as well as the theory of the news gatekeepers. It also uses stories to analyze disputed issues, for example, news objectivism, freedom of the press and national security, and media and election. Learning this course, students will be not only capable of cultivating the ability to read a news correctl

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學選修。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 這e世紀時代的資訊交流是一個廣泛、多樣化與複雜的；究竟人們如何透過溝通表達意識與行為，卻變成非常重要。有效的溝通程度常視為學習溝通的指標，須視事實、竟見、感覺、嗜好和經驗進行徹底地交融與分享的結果。因此，本課程重視現代社會學習「溝通管理」的二項關鍵技術包括：有效溝通結合自我學習技巧和方法：商業知識與科技結合促成人的系統互動能力，配合多媒體傳輸工具完成學習個人與團體溝通效益。課程涵概主題:1.溝通管理定義與本質元素。2.溝通管理內涵分析。3.學習個人溝通能力。4.學習溝通程序。5.e化自我學習技巧、方法與表達能力。6.學習全球化溝通科技工具。7.團隊溝通的策略與協同戰術。8.塑造整體溝通文化。
description.en: The information exchange is wide, variety, and complicated in the e-era; how do people express their consciousness and behavior turn to become very important. Effective communication degrees usually are seen as the index of learning communication. It depends on thoroughly melting and sharing with fact, opinion, feeling, interesting and experience. Therefore, "Communication Management," in this course we emphasize on two key techniques of modern society learning including: effective communication with self-learning skill and method; Business knowledge and technology with interactive ability of human system. By using multimedia transmitting tools to complete self and group learning communication and get benefit.

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學選修。109(含)後：社會與法治

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學核心。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en: Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood. It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學選修。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 透過一系列的資料採集、參考與互動，包含經驗分享、影片欣賞等，帶領修課同學探索創新（Innovation）、創業（Startup）以及最重要的 – 創業家創新精神（Entrepreneur Innovative Thinking）之本質。無論是工作上的創造，學習上的創造，或者是(創)事業上的創造，都必然需要一定程度的創新，才能在全球化競爭以及指數型科技（Exponential Technology）發展的趨勢下存活，最終獲得勝利、創造價值。
description.en: Through series of classes to train students embracing the innovative thinking and gradually internalize it to become innovative entrepreneurship. Since the generation is changing so rapidly, the competitors are no longer came from local land but from everywhere in global village. Under this highly competitive world, every one of us need to fully embrace the true value of innovation, and incubate our own entrepreneurship with hack spirit, which will lead us to an island of innovation.

interdisciplinary: 文化永續與社會創新-社會實踐微學程
notes: 106-108：創新與創業核心。109(含)後：創新與創業

description.zh: 學習相似於Microsoft Power Point 的「拖-拉-點-選」操作方式，再加上一小部份的 Low Code程式編碼，即可以設計與製作出:「專業級的 APP」 !本課程運用學校內的雲端平台: AgilePoint NX，改變了以往撰寫APP 的模式，不再需要撰寫複雜的程式碼，讓學生專注於 APP的邏輯流程與UI(使用者介面)，進而發展貼近市場裡的商業模式，設計出精彩的APP!課程的教學，採用傳統臺北工專的黑手工程師訓練模式:「由經入史」:先講解理論架構，進而延伸到產業的實務運用。嚴格要求上課同學動手實做，達成每週的設定目標。課堂上講師所示範的範例非常豐富，下課後會有一定份量的Homework(實作型作業)。經此系統化訓練，在APP的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。「讓不懂IT(資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的APP! 」
description.en: Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

name.en: Start to APP Design and Application

notes: 106-108：創新與創業選修。109(含)後：創新與創業

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

notes: 106-108：美學與藝術選修。109(含)後：人文與藝術

description.zh: 本課程關注的焦點將以都市文學和民族/文化/現代建構為基底，以“五四”文學以來的總體概述為起始的一個發現之旅。課程將以夏志清的中國現代小說史為起點，進而以李歐梵對於民國初年出版商和作家和他們的貢獻作為對照，來做為現代城市文化風景的呈現。課程中將以安德森”想像的共同體”為背景，解釋它被各種文化論述所引用的觀點，以各種面向來看待文學作品對於民族建構的貢獻。
description.en: We arrange the course that is based on urban literatures, with issues about the race, culture and the construction of the modern world. The students in the course will be guided into a tour of discovery, which is summed up and initiated from “May 4th Movement”. The progress of course will be mapped out from “A History of Modern Chinese Fiction” compiled by C. T. Hsia (夏志清), and then the analysis from Leo Lee, and other writers, will be compared to exhibit the style and features of modern urban literatures. According to the theory of “Imagined Communities” which is authored by B. Anderson, we will also explain the viewpoints from different cultures, and comment on the analyses to the race construction with varied points of view.

name.zh: 二十世紀中國現代文學與文化建構
name.en: The modern literature and cultural construction in twentieth century China

notes: 106-108：歷史與文化選修。109(含)後：人文與藝術

description.zh: 所有人際圈都有倫理問題。家庭有家庭倫理，學校有學習倫理，在職場中則存在著職場倫理關係，有待個人學習理解、奉行。職場倫理是人與工作(生產)組織之間的關係，也可以?就是在職場中的人際關係，其牽涉幾個層面，包括正確的工作態度、正確的價值觀念以及正確的人際關係。職場倫理牽涉到職場中個體或群體對於人際互動判定對錯是非的?為觀?，若不具備或不健全的職場倫理觀念將會導致職場人際圈秩序混亂或被破壞，引來觸犯法律規定底限之懲處不利後果。因此，企業懲戒法律案例形同職場倫理負面教材，可藉之推演人際互動規則、體會個案經驗，來思考合宜的人際往來互動的拿捏取捨。職場倫理議題牽涉禮貌、法律與溝通技巧等多元問題面向。本課程除從理論面演繹職場倫理內涵，亦採企業懲戒個案探討方式，來協助學生習得適應融入職場生活所需之人際相處知識。
description.en: All kinds of relationship involve ethic issue. Ethic of workplace is the relationship between individuals and organizations, meaning a social relationship of workplace. It involves several aspects, including correct work attitudes, values, and personal relationships. Workplace ethic involves ideas individuals and groups hold in workplace to judge right or wrong about behavior. Without correct or sound ethic in workplace may result in chaos or destruction of order among social networks, or offend the legal baseline. Thus, enterprise punishment cases equal negative examples for workplace ethic. Workplace ethic involves topics of manners, laws and communication skills. This course provides not only theoretical perspective to reason nature of workplace ethic, but also raises cases of enterprise punishment for discussions to help students learn knowledge of interactions in workplace to adapt career life.

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學選修。109(含)後：人文與藝術

description.zh: 新經濟與舊經濟的分野不是在有『e』還是沒有『e』，而是在有『i』還是沒有『i』，而『i』就是『Innovation，創新』。二十一世紀的『腦力經濟』最重要的戲規則就是『智慧財產權』，同時也是WTO會員國必須遵守的重要規範之一。課程內容主要包括三個最基本的智慧財產權課題：專利權，商標權，以及著作權；而為配合本校學生學科背景，本課程將較著重於『專利』方面的實務知識，並且講授『如何激發創意，以培養學生日後能好好應用『智慧財產權』的保護。
description.en: The difference between New-economy and Old-economy is not caused by having "e" or not having "e", but caused by owining "i" or not owning "i". where "I" means "Innovation:. Intellectual Property is not only the most importance business rule of the :Brain economy era:, but also one of the most important agreements among WTO members. This course includes the basic three subjects of Intellectual Property:Patent, Trademark, and Copyright. In order to accommodate the learning background for most of NTUT students, the contents of this course will focus more on the practical practice of the Patennt. In addition, it also includes the subject of "how to activate your creativeness:so as to make students can use what they learn, "Intellectual Property:, to protect their intellectual work.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程
notes: 106-108：民主與法治核心。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 「社會心理學」主要探討的重點在於日常生活，社會刺激以及情境如何影響個人行為，它需要經過科學的方法進行研究，藉以預測一個人在某種情境下，可能會出現哪些行為。其涉及的學科相當廣泛，除了一般心理學的理論之外，尚包含社會科學哲學、文化人類學、倫理學、環境心理學、團體動力學等相關論述。課程強調理論與實務結合，提升學生參與社會的知能。
description.en: Social Psychology is focus on social stimuli and how situations affect individual behavior everyday life. In order to predict a person’s behavior in a situation, we need to research by scientific methods. It covers a wide range of professional areas, not only the theories of social psychology but also philosophy of social science, cultural anthropology, ethics, environmental psychology, group dynamics. This course emphasizes the combination of theory and practice to enhance students’ abilities to participate in society.

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學選修。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 本課程之目標為：充實生活技能、提升科技素養、豐富生活內涵、培養繼續進修之興趣與能力，以奠定終身學習及生涯發展之基礎。本課程之內容為：一、電腦基本概念，二、電腦功能與應用，三、資料處理，四、資訊管理，五、資訊網路，六、電腦的聲光世界，七、電腦的安全問題與防治，八、未來的資訊社會。
description.en: This course is designed to help student to learn another skill, better understand technology, enrich there live and inspire their interests for further study. The course includes: 1.basic knowledge of computer; 2.the application of computer; 3.data procession; 4.data control; 5.internet; 6.multimedia; 7.computer virus; 8. the world of information.

interdisciplinary: 資訊安全微學程
notes: 106-108：自然與科學選修。109(含)後：自然與科學

description.zh: 新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避免與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en: Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously.The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

notes: 106-108：創新與創業核心。109(含)後：創新與創業

description.zh: 本課程是為非專業學生所設計的哲學概論，介紹西洋哲學的起源、西洋哲學的問題，以及哲學與人生的關係。哲學的問題意識起自人類的自覺，人類意圖認識自己，為宇宙人生尋求解答，哲學的發生本自人類天賦的求知欲，即其本性中對於智慧的追求與愛慕。這種愛慕智慧的精神是希臘文明留給西方世界的遺產，對於知識能持客觀批判的精神，對於真理能存認真熱切的態度，對於人生能有超克苦難的修持。在國際化的世代，我們對西方的認識應更深入其精神層面，此乃本課程規劃的初衷。
description.en: This course is designed for student who is not disciplined in philosophy. As an introduction, we begin at the origin of western philosophy, the philosophical questions and finally, the relationship of human life and philosophy. Philosophy takes place when human being thinking of himself. Man by nature desire to know himself as well as the external world. And due to this love of wisdom, men can be critical to knowledge and be passionate toward truth. Eventually, grasping the sprit of western philosophy , we can view our life in quite a different view. In our time, facing the world of international, we should better understand the western culture, which is rooted in philosophy.

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學核心。109(含)後：人文與藝術

description.zh: 台灣位處東南亞與東北亞島弧的中介點，是亞洲大陸與太平洋的接點，因此，歷來有許多不同族群移居，因而形成多彩多樣的多元價值觀並容兼蓄的文化觀。本課程將論述介紹台灣南島文化、荷西殖民時期的基督教、漢人文化、日本文化和近代文明等在台灣社會產生的影響。
description.en: The island of Taiwan is located in the middle of the island arc of Southeastern and Northeastern Asia. Further, it is the intersection of the Asian continent and the Pacific Ocean. Since many different ethnic groups have migrated in together, a multi-dimensional view of value-colorful in itself has thus been formed. This course will make a first-step introduction and discussion on the impact over the Taiwan society processed by the cultural mix of the Austronesians, the Christianity under the occupation of the Netherlands and Spain, the Hans, the Japanese and the modern civilization.

name.en: The History and Culture of Taiwan

This course emphasizes the combination of theory and practice to enhance students’ abilities to participate in society.
