Through this course , students can not only get correct concepts of " Labor Law " , but learn to protect their / others' rights in work place.

notes: 106-108：民主與法治選修。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders. Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely. The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing. On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized. Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth. The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學選修。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 資訊法律課程將讓同學了解網路資訊社會中各層面的相關法律議題。本課程內容著重於各種網路法律問題，例如資訊安全、網路契約的訂定、網域名稱、數位化著作權、商標權，隱私權以及電腦犯罪種類及防治的介紹。另外，本課程也以個案方式，敘述電腦資訊的相關法律問題，並從中了解虛擬世界與現實世界的法律規範，同時測試自己是否具備足夠的資訊法律知識，能夠在快速變遷的資訊社會中立足與發展。
description.en: The course of Information Laws is designed for the students to familiarize such legal issues in most of the aspects available in the current world as information security, internet contracts, domain names, digital copy rights, trademark ownership, individual privacy and the genre & prevention in relation to computers. In addition, we discuss individual cases to further understand the nature of legal issues concerning computerized information. Hopefully, we learn the legal disciplines existent in the virtual and real worlds; besides, the students are supposed to equip themselves with sufficient legal knowledge so that they can survive and thus keep growing in the ever-changing information society.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程
notes: 106-108：民主與法治選修。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 中國的崛起正在改變全球的政治、經濟和文化，而台灣與港澳都是已然成型的大中華經濟圈成員，吾人必須要趁早了解中國市場崛起的原因，並開始作好準備。本課程帶領學生深入瞭解中國崛起的背景、所代表的意義、以及如何去面對隨之而來的新挑戰。課程中並將描繪出世界的未來走向、美國霸權的逐日衰退、和各種產業即將面臨的威脅/挑戰/機遇。中國已經成為世界最大的經濟體，未來台灣的企業、經濟前景、甚至個人生活都會感受到巨大的衝擊。中國的經濟成長何以會影響到所有的全球性產業和消費者，並分析許多工作即將面臨的威脅。本課程由總體宏觀角度出發，逐步進入細部剖析，期末再以全球觀點回顧大中華經濟圈的發展，並對未來趨勢提出分析。
description.en: This is an introductory level course on the rise of China as a major power and the emergence of the Greater China Economic Circle. Through intensive reading and in-class discussion, the students are expected to gain an in-depth understanding of the developmental causes, path, and trajectory of the GCEC.Both positive and negative factors will be critically examined in the assigned readings. The role of Taiwan in the development of GCEC will also be reviewed.

notes: 106-108：社會與哲學選修。109(含)後：社會與法治

description.zh: 病毒可說是介於無生命和有生命之間的物質。它小至用光學顯微鏡看不見除非在電子顯微鏡下。儘管看不見卻無所不在，與人類關係異常密切。人類基因體約8%是從病毒來的。目前最難解決的傳染病問題也是由病毒引起。病毒結構看來似乎很簡單，但為了生存也進化出非凡的策略。人類從研究病毒得到非常多重要的知識和研究工具。讓我們能夠對分子、細胞和生物體的結構和功能得到更深地了解，進而對疾病問題得到解決。本課程將以深入簡出的方式讓同學認識病毒: 從病毒的起源，病毒如何進入宿主細胞與複製，並在宿主群體間存活和傳播所必須具備的機制。通過一系列較具代表性的人類病毒為例子進行介紹病毒複製的基礎、人類與病毒的相互作用以及如何導致疾病。同時認識人體4006的免疫系統如何對抗病毒。了解為什麼新興病毒的出現並造成疫情。人類應如何應對。最後介紹兩種不尋常的傳染因子- 類病毒和狂牛病蛋白。它們與病毒似乎都是在生命起源中在化學演化時期殘留下來的分子。
description.en: This course will emphasize the mechanisms necessary for the virus to successfully enter and reproduce in the host cell, and survive and spread in the host population. Through a series of representative examples of human viruses, I will introduce the general basis of virus replication, the interaction between the virus and the host, and how these factors cause diseases and our immune system against virus. Finally, I will briefly introduce two unusual infectious agents- viroid and prion.

name.en: An introduction to virology and unusual infectious agents

notes: 106-108：自然與科學選修。109(含)後：自然與科學

description.zh: 本課程是教授學生人工智慧的基本概念與應用，激發學生在人工智慧領域的創新應用。課程內容包括: 人工智慧基礎、機器學習、大數據技術、深度學習、生成對抗網路、創業家思維、設計思考、商業模式、人工智慧與現代科技、人工智慧的製造業應用、人工智慧的服務業應用。
description.en: This course is to teach students the basic concepts and applications of artificial intelligence and to inspire students for innovative artificial intelligence applications. The course includes: artificial intelligence basics, machine learning, big data, deep learning, generative adversarial network, entrepreneurial thoughts, design thinking, business models, artificial intelligence and modern technologies, industrial applications of artificial intelligence, and services applications of artificial intelligence.

interdisciplinary:
人工智慧科技學程
工程數位科技與人工智慧微學程
人工智慧賦能跨域應用微學程
notes: 106-108：創新與創業選修。109(含)後：創新與創業

description.zh: 介紹新興生醫產業的趨勢與其跨領域之特性。課程內容含: 生醫產業簡介, 新世紀人類基因體大計畫, 微生物工程新應用, 新型蛋白質藥劑之開發, 分子醫療診斷之革新, 生醫產業之電腦新科技, 遠距醫療服務新模式, 創新健康管理與保險制度的創新, 生醫產業與科技法律, 生醫產業與社會倫理, 幹細胞新產業, 組織再生新產業, 超級老鼠的誕生, 美美的生醫美容, 抗癌症研究之新科技, 抗傳染疾病之新科技。評分的方式以學生報告為主。
description.en: The course is to introduce the trends and the characteristics of biomedical industries in the new millennium. The course covers areas such as human genome project, biotechnology application with microbes, new protein drug, innovative medical technology, computation biology in biomedical industries, new business models in telemedicine, health care management and innovative insurance trends, technology laws in biomedical industries, social responsibility and biomedical industries, stem cell technology, new industries from tissue engineering and so on. The grading method of the course is based on the oral and written reports.

name.zh: 新世紀生醫產業創新科技
name.en: Innovative biomedical industries in the new millennium

notes: 高分所合開

description.zh: 介紹新興生醫產業的趨勢與其跨領域之特性。課程內容含: 生醫產業簡介, 新世紀人類基因體大計畫, 微生物工程新應用, 新型蛋白質藥劑之開發, 分子醫療診斷之革新, 生醫產業之電腦新科技, 遠距醫療服務新模式, 創新健康管理與保險制度的創新, 生醫產業與科技法律, 生醫產業與社會倫理, 幹細胞新產業, 組織再生新產業, 超級老鼠的誕生, 美美的生醫美容, 抗癌症研究之新科技, 抗傳染疾病之新科技。評分的方式以學生報告為主。
description.en: The course is to introduce the trends and the characteristics of biomedical industries in the new millennium. The course covers areas such as human genome project, biotechnology application with microbes, new protein drug, innovative medical technology, computation biology in biomedical industries, new business models in telemedicine, health care management and innovative insurance trends, technology laws in biomedical industries, social responsibility and biomedical industries, stem cell technology, new industries from tissue engineering and so on. The grading method of the course is based on the oral and written reports.

name.zh: 新世紀生醫產業創新科技
name.en: Innovative biomedical industries in the new millennium

notes: 分四合開

description.zh: 現代性源自於歐洲獨有的歷史文化與社會，在工業化、理性化和民主化的推波助瀾下綻放開來，促使人們從神話、威權和中心性解放出來，擺脫傳統社會的制約。透過現代性的反證精神和批判性概念，歐洲幾乎於整個二十世紀初開展出驚人的物質和人類意識的進程。而建築的生產與整個社會、經濟、政治和審美價值緊密相關的專業，又是如何以自身作為對於現代性的批判?本課程將以辨明現代性概念為主軸，透過阿道夫·魯斯(Adolf Loos)、西格弗里德·吉迪恩(Sigfried Giedion)、華特·班雅明(Walter Benjamin)、恩斯特·布洛赫(Ernst Bloch)、和威尼斯學派(Venice School)的論說作為理解現代性含混而艱澀的觀念，並藉由藝術和建築作品的探索，作為對於現代性的批判與理念的參照，包括前衛派藝術對於建築的衝擊、新巴比倫的城市景觀社會反論、建築的擬仿和批判等等。
description.en: The term “Modernity” originated from the unique European history, culture, and societal condition, bloomed with the development of industrialization, rationalization and democratization. That have inspired human to liberate from mythology, authority and centrality, and get rid of the constraints of traditional society. With the antithesis and critical concepts of modernity, Europe has carried out an amazing progress of material and human consciousness almost throughout the twentieth century. How does architecture as a profession closely related to the entire society, economy, politics, and aesthetic approach, in the process of production implemented itself as a critique of modernity?In the beginning of the class, it would be most important to identify the concepts of Modernity. The discourses of Adolf Loos, Sigfried Giedion, Walter Benjamin, Ernst Bloch, and the Venetian School help to clarify the vague and difficult concepts of modernity. Through the exploration of art and arc

name.zh: 現代性與建築名作研討
name.en: Seminar on Modernity and Architecture Masterpiece

notes: 建築四、日職建都所合開

description.zh: 介紹及討論創造性藝術之特性、藝術與工程間的關連、美學在工程上之重要性以及美的形式原理。
description.en: This course is an introduction to the study and practice of fundamental principles of design in terms of creative arts, relationship between art and engineering, and the importance of aesthetics applying to design.

notes: 創意一、工設二、建築二合開，開放外系選課。

description.zh: 隨著跨學門的多元連結,當代建築學的設計與史論研究向度越趨廣泛且複雜。為回應此變動的條件,研究方法作為知識體系建構的工具,亦需重新思考如何提供理解當代建築學和認識論的新興維度。因此,本課程首先以「研究為一門藝術的概念」-透過理解自身意識與研究的關係,作為開啟研究的初步引導。接著,將從人文社會科學研究方法的基礎出發,探討如何在建築學門內適切轉化及運用此些方法。透過本課程,學習者將能夠有效辯證和梳理不同研究主體(知識論)以及該研究所對應之方法邏輯(方法論),並以此作為設計研究的基礎建構。同時,期待學習者能夠理解在建築研究中,學門的部分特殊性質所衍伸出的方法論修正,並鼓勵為當代建築設計與史論研究提供新的思路。
description.en: With the growing interdisciplinary connections, contemporary architectural design, theoretical research, and historical dimensions have become increasingly expansive and intricate. In response to these evolving conditions, research methods, as essential tools for constructing knowledge systems, need to be reconsidered in order to offer fresh insights into understanding contemporary architecture and its epistemology.This course starts by embracing the concept of "research as an art" as a foundational guide to initiate research, emphasizing the crucial relationship between self-awareness and the research process. It then builds upon the established research methods in the humanities and social sciences, exploring how to effectively adapt and apply these methods within the field of architecture. Throughout the course, learners will learn to skillfully articulate and organize diverse research subjects (epistemology) and their corresponding methodological frameworks (methodology), estab

name.zh: 建築設計與理論研究方法

notes: 甲組學生必修，甲組老師共授

description.zh: 專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。
description.en: Case Study, Seminars, Group meeting

notes: 電資資安、創新資安 合開/國際會議廳

description.zh: 以講授刑法基本概念的犯罪論、罪數論及刑罰論為主軸；並輔以相關案例的檢討、分析，以使同學對於抽象的概念及學理，得以理解及適用。目的除在強化同學對維護個人、社會、國家等法益的體認外，亦在奠定學習刑法各論的基礎。
description.en: The course focuses on the introduction to the fundamental ideas of the criminal law such as the criminal theory, crime arithmetic and punishment theory. Many relevant cases are presented in the class for further discussion and analysis. The ultimate objective of the course is not only to enhance the students a deeper understanding of the rights granted to individuals, society and nations, but also to equip them with a wider knowledge base ready for a further studying on each specific section of the Criminal Law.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程
notes: 人數限制40人

description.zh: 民主政治為法治政治，凡政府各項施政均需有法令依據。行政法，乃是國家各行政機關所適用之各種法令規章之總稱，其內容含蓋國家行政機關之組織、職權、作用、程序及爭訟等事項之法規，範圍至為廣泛，且與人民之權利、義務息息相關。本課程將以系統化、生動化，並輔以實例之方式講授，以啟發同學學習興趣。同學修習本課程，除可增進法治知能與素養外，並可對日常生活之權益維護有重大裨益。
description.en: Democracy is regarded as rule by law nowadays. All official policies that are implemented by government must be based on law. Administrative law is a general term of all kinds of regulations and laws that are suitable for administrative organizations. The content includes of administrative organization in this country. The course serves as extensive rules that are related to people is rights and obligations. The principle emphasis of the course is on the systematic instruction with specific examples enlighten students learning interest, furthermore not only promoting knowledge and professional training in law but also effective in daily life.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程
notes: 人數限制40人

description.zh: 民法總則介紹民法中的共通概念與基本原則，為整部民法以及所有法律的學習基礎。透過民法總則之學習，同學可以熟悉法律的思考模式及規範架構。本課程將以理論與實務並重方式協助同學學習。
description.en: The General Principle of the Civil Law serves to introduce the common concept and fundamental principle of the Civil Law. In short, the General Principle of the Civil Law predominates as a learning basis for the whole Civil Law and all legal study. Through learning on the General Principle of the Civil Law, students can be familiar with the model of legal thought and the framework of norm. This course aims to assist students learning from both theory and practice.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 無論就量而言或就質而言，債編均為民法中最為重要之部分。本課程旨在向修課同學作民法債編之概括介紹，包括債編總論及債編各論。再者，此一介紹包含下列四個重點：一、民法債編之背景及理論二、民法債編之解釋三、民法債編於案例事實之適用四、民法債編與民法其他部分及民事訴訟法之結合參與本課程乃理解民法債編及民法整體之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。
description.en: "Obligations" is the most important part of the Civil Law, not only in quantity but in quality. This course aims to give participants a general introduction to "Obligations", including "General Provisions for Obligations" and "Kinds of Obligations". Furthermore, the introduction contains the following four points:1. Background and theories of "Obligations".2. Interpretation of "Obligations".3. Application of "Obligations" to the facts.4. Combination of "Obligations", other parts of the Civil Law and the Civil Procedure Law.Attending this course is the critical step to understanding "Obligations" and the Civil Law as a whole, and it benefits participants a lot.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程
notes: 1週;建議修過民法總則【停開】

description.zh: 本課程將以智慧財產局頒布之「專利審查基準」為藍本，依「先程序後實體」原則先就「程序審查」部分介紹專利申請之程序，再就專利申請之「實體審查」部分依序說明專利說明書暨圖式之構成、可專利類型、產業利用性、新穎性、進步性等專利要件，先申請原則、發明單一性及優先權。
description.en: This course will be based on the "Patent Examination Guidelines" issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office, and introduces the procedure for patent application according to the principle of "formality before substantive examination". Firstly, in the "formality examination" section, topics such as the constitution of a patent specification and drawings, the allowable subject matter for patents, utility, novelty, inventiveness and other patent elements, the first-to-file rule, unity of invention, and the priority of an patent application, will be sequentially discussed.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程
notes: 1週【停開】

description.zh: 商標法係為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展所制定之法律。商標得以文字、圖形、記號、顏色、聲音、 立體形狀或其聯合式所組成，並應足以使商品或服務之相關消費者認識其為表彰商品或服務之標識，藉以與他人之商品或服務相區別。凡因表 彰自己之商品或服務，欲取得商標權者，應依該法申請註冊。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於商標法的瞭解。
description.en: Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and consumers' interest, maintain fair competitions of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce.A trademark may be composed of a word, design, symbol, color, sound, three-dimensional shape or a combination thereof.A trademark as defined above shall be distinctive enough for relevant consumers of the goods or services to recognize it as identification to those goods or services and to differentiate such goods or services from those offered by others.A person who wishes to obtain trademark rights in order to distinguish its goods or services shall apply for trademark registration as provided under this Act.The discussion in the course covers theory and examples，to enhance a deeper understanding of Trademark Act for the students.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 本課程將深入我國專利法，同時簡介美國及大陸專利法。本課程內容主要涵蓋：專利申請、可專利標的、專利要件及要求、專利審查流程、專利權之實施、專利侵害判斷、專利檢索及專利說明書之撰寫。其他內容尚包括簡介專利訴訟流程、專利行政救濟流程、法院及智慧財產局之角色以及專利法與其他智慧財產權法之關係。
description.en: This course will go through R.O.C. (Taiwan) patent law in detail, and introduce to the U.S. and China patent laws. Topics will mainly include patent filing, patentable subject matter, patent conditions and requirements, patent examination procedure, patent enforcement, patent infringement assessment, patent search, and patent drafting. Other topics include introduce to patent litigation procedure, patent administrative suit procedure, the roles of the court and the Intellectual Property Office and the relationship between patent law and other Intellectual Property laws.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 本課程旨在透過案例研析介紹智慧財產權之理論與實務問題。課程進行的方式是邀請學界或實務界專家學者，以演講的方式講解相關智慧財產權案例所涉法律問題，並安排參訪智慧財產權實務單位（如專利事務所、智慧財產局、智慧財產法院等），讓同學們得以一窺智慧財產權實務工作的全貌，以達實務與理論相輔相成的功效。
description.en: The course offers introduction to the practice and theory knowledge of Intellectual Property by case study . The course is conducted through lectures of practical subject . It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the practice of Intellectual Property is performed in our country .

name.en: Seminar on Intellectual Property Right Cases

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程
notes: 2週【停開】

description.zh: 新經濟與舊經濟的分野不是在有『e』還是沒有『e』，而是在有『i』還是沒有『i』，而『i』就是『Innovation，創新』。二十一世紀的『腦力經濟』最重要的戲規則就是『智慧財產權』，同時也是WTO會員國必須遵守的重要規範之一。課程內容主要包括三個最基本的智慧財產權課題：專利權，商標權，以及著作權；而為配合本校學生學科背景，本課程將較著重於『專利』方面的實務知識，並且講授『如何激發創意，以培養學生日後能好好應用『智慧財產權』的保護。
description.en: The difference between New-economy and Old-economy is not caused by having "e" or not having "e", but caused by owining "i" or not owning "i". where "I" means "Innovation:. Intellectual Property is not only the most importance business rule of the :Brain economy era:, but also one of the most important agreements among WTO members. This course includes the basic three subjects of Intellectual Property:Patent, Trademark, and Copyright. In order to accommodate the learning background for most of NTUT students, the contents of this course will focus more on the practical practice of the Patennt. In addition, it also includes the subject of "how to activate your creativeness:so as to make students can use what they learn, "Intellectual Property:, to protect their intellectual work.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 本課主要講授公司法的規定。相關的法律理論都會被介紹。學生將被指定閱讀教科書和法院判決。課堂參與是必要的。
description.en: This course teaches Company Act. Company Act covers procedural rules of incorporation, duties of a president, board members, or shareholders. Students will be assigned to read a textbook and several court decisions. Class participation is required.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 法學概論，顧名思義是在介紹法律原理，以啟發學生法學研究的興趣。然而，法學涵蓋的層面甚廣，法學緒論的課程，只能大略介紹各種法律的共通原理，就繁駁的法律現象，作綜合的引說，俾使初學法律的人，不僅能粗知「實定法」的共通原則，還可藉此原則來培養法律見解和修養，執簡馭繁，因而體會法律的性質、內涵和理念。有關本課程的教授方式，擬先介紹法律的基概念及原理，並以答問之方式訓練學生邏輯反思的能力，同時輔以日常屢見之法律實例問題。如此，學生不僅可以可以學習正確的法律觀念和知識，並可培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，以達保障並維護自己及他人權益之目的。
description.en: Introduction of Law is to introduce the theory of law and to promote students' interest to study law. Since the field of law is very broad but the time is limited, this course can briefly explain common principles of law, complex phenomena of law, etc. The main purpose of this course is to let students catch the concept of common principles of "lex scripta." Also, this course aims to promote students' knowledge about law, thus cultivating their spirit of abiding by law. This course will introduce the basic concept and theory of law first. Then students will be given logical training through discussion. Besides, the general cases and problems of law will be covered as well. Through this course, students can not only get correct concepts of law, but learn to protect their/others' right.

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程
notes: 社會與法治向度

description.zh: 近年來各大學積極推動「大學社會責任實踐（University Social Responsibility, USR）計畫」，期許大學師生對在地方發展及公共議題發揮熱情與創意，與地方居民及企業協力推動社區及產業發展。大學社會責任工作主要是透過社會創新，解決社會問題，來實踐社會責任所謂社會創新，就是用創新的方法來解決社會問題，產生「社會影響力」（Social Impact），並設法改變處在社會問題「當中的人」以及與這個人有關的「社會情境」（social context），來產生長久的社會影響本課程，將向同學生講解社會責任基本觀念，以介紹學社會責任的理念構想與實踐經驗，並移地教學，地方場域問題作為主題報告討論素材等方式，來增強學生進行社會創新的態度、認知和行為。
description.en: In recent years, universities have actively promoted the "University Social Responsibility (USR) Program", expecting university teachers and students to show enthusiasm and creativity in local development and public issues, and work with local residents and enterprises to promote community and industrial development. This course will explain the basic concepts of social responsibility to the students, introduce the concepts and practical experience of each USR project team of our school, and use the case experience to share and discuss, and use USR field issues as the topic report discussion material. Guide students to participate in university social responsibility work, and enhance the attitude, cognition and behavior of social innovation.

notes: 106-108：創新與創業選修。109(含)後：創新與創業

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。1.電磁波在介質中的傳導 2.光纖光學 3.光纖種類及特性 4.發光器5.接收器 6.中繼站及光放大器 7.光纖通訊系統 8.光纖網路
description.en: 1.Electromagnetic ware propagation in media 2.Fiber optics3.Characteristics of optic fibers 4.Optical emitter 5. Optical receiver 6.Repeater and optical amplifier 7.Optical fiber communication 8.Optical fiber network

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

interdisciplinary: 創業家精神微學程

description.zh: 隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

interdisciplinary: 生醫輔助科技跨域微學程

description.zh: 輔具是輔助器具的簡稱，舉凡日常生活，能使活動更容易、方便的各種用具皆屬之，正確的使用輔具可以改變身心障礙者或老年人原本有障礙的生活，走入社會，降低社會成本。本課程為專案導向課程，課程中除教授輔具設計基本概念，透過實際個案訪談分析目標對象，以工作坊形式找出使用者痛點，進而發展解決方案，提出適切的輔具資源，以幫助身心障礙者或老年人族群。
description.en: Assistive device is the abbreviation of auxiliary equipment. For everyday life, all kinds of utensils that make activities easier and convenient belong to it. Correct use of assistive device can change the life of people with physical and mental disabilities or the elderly who have obstacles, and enter the society and reduce Social costs. This is a project-oriented course. The course introduces the concept of auxiliary equipment; students can also analyze target audience through different case studies. During workshops, it helps students indicate users’ pain points and develop the solutions. The goal of this course is to come out with the resources to help people with disabilities or the elderly.

interdisciplinary: 生醫輔助科技跨域微學程

description.zh: 課程將以體驗式教學訓練，提升學員表達技巧、舞台技巧、臨場反應。本課程主要目的在教授學生以設計思考思維與策略，運用主題式課程實戰小組簡報及個人簡報，快速釐清簡報製作及表達過程中重點，提升修課學員個人簡報製作能力及表達能力，幫助學生在未來創業及就業上以出色之個人簡報能力獲得面試者及投資者的青睞，領先於起跑點取得優勢。
description.en: The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

name.zh: 企業最愛：高質感簡報溝通力
name.en: Corporate's Favorite: High-quality Communication and Presentation Ability

interdisciplinary: 創業家精神微學程

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

name.en: Feast for the global perspective—Essential Leadership communication skills

notes: 全英授課/台北大學陳尹珊老師/實際授課時間/ 四 5、6

description.zh: 本課程藉由邀請校內外之社會、政治、經濟、文化等專家學者與莘莘學子們進行相互交流，透過「全球議題」、「文化學習」等主題之進階探討，培養學生世界公民之意識，重新定位自己，以適應全球化生活與培養終身競爭力。修習本課程之學生需於學期中規劃辦理一場國際型實務展演活動，邀校內國際生及本國生共襄盛舉，達到實質國際人才互動。
description.en: We invite the domestic speakers, as the outstanding scholars of cross-cultural communication, to share their knowledge and experiences with students. By exploring the global issues such as social, cultural, political or economic studies, the course makes students learn further about the world, and inspires students to strengthen their independent thinking and global perspective.

description.en: Graduate students are required to complete a specific research topic under the instruction of their advisor(s). The results should be written as a thesis.

description.zh: 輔具是輔助器具的簡稱，舉凡日常生活，能使活動更容易、方便的各種用具皆屬之，正確的使用輔具可以改變身心障礙者或老年人原本有障礙的生活，走入社會，降低社會成本。本課程為專案導向課程，課程中除教授輔具設計基本概念，透過實際個案訪談分析目標對象，以工作坊形式找出使用者痛點，進而發展解決方案，提出適切的輔具資源，以幫助身心障礙者或老年人族群。
description.en: Assistive device is the abbreviation of auxiliary equipment. For everyday life, all kinds of utensils that make activities easier and convenient belong to it. Correct use of assistive device can change the life of people with physical and mental disabilities or the elderly who have obstacles, and enter the society and reduce Social costs. This is a project-oriented course. The course introduces the concept of auxiliary equipment; students can also analyze target audience through different case studies. During workshops, it helps students indicate users’ pain points and develop the solutions. The goal of this course is to come out with the resources to help people with disabilities or the elderly.

description.en: The course "Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering" will introduce the basic knowledge of satellite systems and subsystems to cultivate the fundamental abilities needed for designing satellite missions. The course content includes: the basic principles of satellites, satellite design and manufacturing, satellite operation and maintenance, satellite communication and remote sensing applications, and satellite development trends.

interdisciplinary: 低軌衛星系統應用微學程

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹電子科技產業趨勢及智權管理策略，第一部分介紹電子科技產業發展趨勢；第二部分介紹一般科技產業之智權管理策略與模式；第三部分以個案研討方式，帶領學生討論產業之智慧財產權管理實務，包含品牌管理、專利佈局策略、商標申請與運用、著作權議題、營業秘密之保護等相關案例。
description.en: This course will introduce the industrial trends and IP management strategies, including the followings: 1. development trend of electronic technology industry, 2. IP management strategies and model of technology industry, 3. To discuss the intellectual property management practices of the related industries, including brand management, patent portfolio strategies, trademark application strategies, copyright issues, the protection of business secrets and other related cases.

name.zh: 電子科技產業智權管理
name.en: IP Management in Electronic Technology Industry

interdisciplinary: 科技法律學程

description.zh: 本課程介紹以ARM CPU為核心之嵌入式系統。內容包含：ARM CPU基礎架構，ARM CPU指令集，ARM之C語言工具，ARM 發展環境，開發電路板，模擬器，Linux驅動程式之撰寫及安裝，分散式網路架構，以及應用實例。
description.en: This course introduces small single-board computers serving as embedded systems and explains the architecture of X86 and ARM CPUs. This lecture will present the history of the ARM development environment, emulators, distributed network architectures, and industrial applications of ARM architecture. In the course, students learn to install Linux on development boards and write software to communicate with ARM processors. The exercises involve setting commands for the ARM cores and receiving signals from our embedded systems using C language tools.

name.zh: 工控嵌入式與分散式系統
name.en: Industrial Control Embedded and Distributed Systems

description.en: Students in this course will begin by writing Python object-oriented programs, followed by developing various types of applications to familiarize themselves with Python object-oriented programs, and are instructed to utilize various application libraries to get acquainted with Python features and to apply them to applications such as artificial intelligence, image processing, web data crawling, etc.

description.en: This course is to explain definition of the knowledge, classification of the knowledge and generation and transfer of the knowledge. Moreover, the innovation of the knowledge will be discussed. Using knowledge management, it will improve the efficiency of the production and operation of the business. The applications and examples of the knowledge management will be included.

notes: 資財所和職機電所、職製科所合開

description.zh: 本課程為本校「智慧鐵道學程」的課程。課程開授之目標，是希望藉由實務傳承與實際場域參訪的方式，使修課學生能夠瞭解鐵道產業的內涵，並對國內鐵道產業的運作現況，有全面性的認識。本課程是以同時段合院授課的方式、針對選讀學程之學生、邀請鐵道事業單位（包括鐵道局、台鐵、北捷、桃捷、高鐵、鐵道建設規劃顧問公司等）、具十年以上相關工作經驗的專業人員、以業師的身份共同參與授課。本課程會安排實際場域（台鐵、北捷、桃捷）參訪交流行程，並會要求修課同學於期末報告時，針對國內鐵道產業現況提出具體建言。
description.en: This course is one of the courses for the Intelligent Rail Curriculum. The main purpose of this course is, via practical technology lecturing and on-site field visiting, to provide the students an overall understanding of the contents and the operational situation of domestic rail industry.This course is a joint lecture among departments inside our college with synchronized class hours. The industrial instructors to our participant students include senior professional practitioners with more than 10-year experiences from Ministry of Railway, Taiwan Railway Bureau (TRB), Taipei MRT, Taoyuan MRT, Taiwan High Speed Rail, and Consultant Agencies for Railway construction, etc. Field trips to operation sites such as TRB, Taipei MRT and Taoyuan MRT, will be scheduled. Each student will also need to submit a term paper regarding the review and suggestion for the domestic rail industry.

interdisciplinary: 智慧鐵道微學程
notes: 車輛三、四合開

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。在以使用者情境設計導向的基礎架構下，本課程的內如包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
description.en: The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

description.zh: 本課程將探討半導體材料之表面化學性質之分析技巧、以及界面和分子間引力之量測方法、表面形態分析、晶相結構分析以及電磁性質量測之技術和其原理。並針對半導體材料的特性，實際操作拉曼及FTIR顯微鏡、原子力顯微鏡、x光光電能譜、以及材料晶相、機械、電磁特性相關設備。
description.en: This course will present the techniques and their corresponding theories on the surface property measurements including chemical information, stress analysis, morphology, crystalline structure and intermolecular forces between interfaces. The course also includes a practical training on the Raman/FTIR microscope, atomic force microscope, x-ray photoelectric spectrometer. Furthermore, instruments to measure crystalline, micro-mechanical, and electrical properties specifically for semiconductor materials will also be introduced.

name.zh: 半導體材料檢測技術及原理

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break　or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 本課程之學習目標是要讓學生的技能持續進步，不因課業而荒廢，學生必須每星期五至企業實習1天。若學生無法媒合到企業，則須回到原來培訓單位，協助訓練選手，或以暑假至企業實習。
description.en: The learning goal of this course is to allow students to continue to improve their skills, not to be abandoned by the coursework. Students must intern for 1 day every Friday to the enterprise. If students cannot match to the enterprise, they must return to the original training unit to help training the other athletes, or take an internship to the enterprise during the summer vacation.

notes: 技優專班

description.zh: 本課程之目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生必須利用暑假至機械、車輛、冷凍空調相關機構實習，參與校外合作企業或研發機構所提供之訓練，學習專業技術之運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核。學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，再由指導教師依據學生之心得報告及現場訪評，撰寫實習成果報告交給系上保存，並給予評分。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to improve students' practical ability. Students must use summer vacation to practice in machinery, vehicles, refrigeration and air conditioning related institutions, participate in training provided by off-campus cooperative enterprises or R&D institutions, and learn the operation of professional technology. After the internship period expires, the internship institution must issue an internship certificate and performance assessment. Students must write an internship experience report, and then the instructor will write the internship achievement report to the department for preservation and score based on the student's experience report and on-site interview and evaluation.

notes: 技優專班

description.zh: 1.安排至企業實習，每星期五實習一天。2.參加國手選拔，到企業、原培訓單位、或職訓中心實習。3.回原培訓單位，協助訓練選手，經驗傳承。
description.en: 1. Arrange for internship in companies, on every Friday.2. Participate in the selection of national players, and practice in enterprises, original training units, or vocational training centers.3. Return to the original training unit to help train the players and transfer their experience.

The object is to provide a fundamental understanding upon offshore wind so that the students can quickly apply what they have learned to solve quality and standard problems. The course is particularly suitable for students who are interested in the subject of offshore wind mechatronics certification.

description.zh: 為加強學生設計實務能力，本課程規劃學生利用暑假赴設計相關產業實習，實習總時數不低於320小時為原則，並於期滿後須由接受實習單位提具實習證明及成績考核。次一學期開學後，學生必須繳交書面或經口頭實習成果發表，由指導教師檢核實習單位成績考核，以給予實習學生最後評量成績。
description.en: For the purpose of enhance senior students' practical skill in design, the course is established to encourage students to intern in the industry for no less than 320 hours. The student will then be evaluated by the industry, and by the lecturer through the examination of a written report and/or an oral presentation to demonstrate his/her effort.

notes: 工設系(選修)

description.zh: 互動設計專注於使用情境相關課題，包括多元感覺的產品語意、資訊與功能的整體設計。顧及使用者的需求、使用者的心理和使用者的認知特性；將所有參與互動的操作及顯示單元，透過視覺、觸覺及聽覺等多元感覺的整合設計。使得使用者容易理解。
description.en: This course provides study of interaction design related topics on Product Semantics, Information and Function. With emphasis on User Interface integration and Usability Testing, psychology and cognitive proactive, the course will be characterized by inter-disciplinary on multi-median. This is where the user easy understanding applies and interacts with the product.

description.zh: 本課程為產品設計專案程序之理論與實務設計與創造性思考，專案與程序，劇本法邏輯，目標澄清，設計研究與調查，構想展開與評估，細部改善，語意法，專案設計策略。
description.en: This course focuses on concept and methods on product design project. It includes: Design Logic, Scenario Planning, Expression, Legibility, Semantics, Problem Solving, Concept Generation Evolution, Technology and Market.

notes: EMI中文

description.zh: 本課程旨在教授學生如何運用創意編程和視覺化電腦圖形技術，將資料及音訊數據轉換為可視化之2D或3D視覺內容，藉以增進資料及音訊之閱聽體驗。課程進行中，學生將習得多種基於演算法之視覺表現方式，以滿足設計層面中富含躍動感、平衡感以及美感之體驗需求，活用創意編程與新媒體技術來創建更生動、更具有影響力的動靜態視聽影像。
description.en: This course aims to teach students how to utilize the knowledge from data science and computer graphics technology to represent data and audio into visualized 2D/3D representations, which gives rise to enhanced experiences of reading and listening. Students will learn a variety of programming skills to design visual representation based on algorithms to deliver dynamic, balanced and aesthetic experiences. With the help of creative coding and new media technology, more vivid and influential static and dynamic visual and audio experiences will be generated.

interdisciplinary: 多媒體人機互動應用與設計微學程

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度,帶領同學進行多感官回饋技術的實作及實驗。從實作及實驗中學生將了解不同回饋技術在應用面上的可能性及其設計考量,並學習人機互動系統的啟發式評估、沉浸式量表、半結構式訪談,從而剖析及理解人機互動系統的表現(程式語言:C++)。此外本課程將以小組實習方式來進行,期望藉由合作學習和雛型製作來強化學生跨領域提案之創新能力。
description.en: The main goal of this course is to guide students to implement and experiment with multisensory feedback technologies from an application and design perspective. Through hands-on exercises and experiments, students will understand the capabilities of different feedback technologies in terms of application and design considerations, and learn heuristic evaluation, immersive scale, and semi-structured interviews of human-computer interaction systems to analyze and understand the performance of human-computer interaction systems (programming language: C++). In addition, this course will take the form of group exercises in the innovative ability to strengthen students' cross-field proposals through cooperative learning and prototyping skill.

name.zh: 多感官回饋技術應用與設計

interdisciplinary: 多媒體人機互動應用與設計微學程
notes: 排先鋒

description.zh: 偏微分方程式、變分法、張量分析、工程統計及積分方程式等工程分析用工具知識。
description.en: Partial Differential equation, Variation Principle, Tensor Analysis, Engineering Statistics and Integral equation.

notes: 機電所、製科所和機電外生班合開/限30人

description.zh: 本課程將從基礎深度學習理論、邊緣智慧硬體應用、資料集建置、客製化模型訓練到推論環境佈署，讓學員透過Google Colab, Intel OpenVINO, OpenCV等開源工具，學習如何規畫及實踐不同類型的低功耗、低延時、低成本及高隱私的邊緣智慧應用專案。
description.en: This course will cover basic deep learning theory, edge smart hardware application, data set construction, customized model training, and inference environment deployment. Allowing students to learn how to plan and practice types of edge smart application with low power consumption, low latency, low cost, and high privacy features.

notes: 電子四甲乙丙合開

description.zh: 本課程探討資訊系統在現代組織中所扮演的角色，課程重點將放在企業電子化和電子商務，同學在修課過後將具備相關知識。課堂中的資訊實務技術演練，將有助於同學有效率地解決相關問題。
description.en: This course provides the knowledge you need to understand the role of information systems in modern organizations, with particular focus on E-commerce and E-business. Along with skills learned in your functional area, knowledge from this course will help you effectively use information technology for solving business problems.

description.zh: 本課程主要教授學生力法、位法及矩陣之基本應用：(1)傾角變位法、(2)力矩分配法、(3)能與補能之觀念、(4)矩陣結構力法、(5)矩陣結構變位法、(6)直接勁度法、(7)結構穩定之介紹 。
description.en: Fundamental theory of statically indeterminate structures;analysis of indeterminate beams,frames,and trusses by stiffness and flexibility methods;study of influence lines for beams,frames,and trusses.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。本課程主要介紹幾何光學與Coherent光學兩部份之基本概念與應用﹐提供機械領域的學生有關光的知識﹐讓機械領域的學生有能力加入機光電技術整合。本課程首先介紹幾何光學﹐幾何光學雖然簡單﹐卻是光學應用最普遍的知識﹐接著進入Coherent光學原理與應用介紹﹐Coherent光學在光量測技術部份佔了非常重要的地位﹐透過本課程的訓練﹐學生將可更順利的進入光學實驗室工作﹐當然﹐本課程也適合其他對光學有興趣的學生來修習。
description.en: The lectures in this course include two main parts, the geometrical and the coherent optics. Due to the future high technology, the optomechatronics, needs the cooperation of knowledge among the optics, the electrics, and the mechanics. This course gives the students of mechanical engineering the chance to participate in this work group. The lecture will first show the students the geometrical optics which is simple but important in the field of optical application. The coherent optics is the main part in this course which occupies the most optical technique of measurement. After the course the students should have the enough knowledge to work in the optical laboratory. Certainly, this course is also useful for all students who are interest in the area of the optics.

A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement.

description.zh: 本課程主要自營建工程專案之觀點，介紹一些常用營建專案管理方法之基本原理及其在電腦上之應用實例。課程內容將包含營建專案之進度、成本、品質等基本管理概念與營建管理理論於專案管理之初步應用，使學生能實際地學習如何將電腦應用在營建工程專案管理(內容包括：工程排程、成本估算與控制、電腦模擬、與工程風險管理分析等方法)。
description.en: This course will provide students with the computational fundamental skills necessary to plan and manage the construction management (such as schedule, cost, and quality management) using related computer project management software or system packages. Students will learn to mix and match available resources in the most efficient combinations to complete projects on time and within budget. Furthermore, the student may utilize computational programming to efficiently plan and execute municipal infrastructure programs (simulations and analysis) and support contractors’ decisions in constrained projects.

description.zh: 本課程將使用時下最新生成式人工智慧工具介紹人工智慧原理及其於大數據分析及智慧計算之應用，進行數據預處理，建立並優化訓練模型。課程內容包括監控生產線上各種數據，如產品品質、生產效率等。通過即時警報和提示，幫助管理人員快速識別並解決問題。藉由學習和分析過往的故障記錄和維修日誌，預測和診斷產設備，提供相應的維護建議。幫助企業實現定期維護和檢修，從而減少設備故障率和生產停機時間。進行自動識別和分類缺陷，並提供改進建議，從而提高產品品質和生產效率。
description.en: This course makes use of the state-of-the-art (SOTA) tools of generative artificial intelligence (AI) to introduce the principles of artificial intelligence and its applications in big data, including data preprocessing, model building, and AI model hyper-parameterization. The course focuses on various types of production-related data. By monitoring shop floor real-time data, production engineers may quickly identify and resolve abnormalities. By learning and analyzing past failure records and maintenance logs, the system may predict and diagnose production errors and provide predictive schedules for equipment maintenance. It helps companies to find a better balance between equipment failure occurrence and production scheduled downtime. The course includes applications in automatic pattern identification, recognition, and classification to assist decision-makers in improving product quality and production efficiency.

description.en: This course will introduce basic concept and application of advanced operation management. The topics addressed in this course include: (1) Basic concept and application of intelligent operations management, (2) Big data analytic and operations management, (3) Artificial intelligence and operations management, (4) IoT and operations management, (5) Smart manufacturing and operations management, (6) Intelligent logistic management, (7) Intelligent supply chain management, (8) Intelligent production planning and scheduling, (9)Sustainable operations management.

notes: 工管四甲乙丙合開

description.zh: 此課程旨在以使用者為中心的觀點，說明產品與服務之開發與設計相關概念，並以實作方式應用使用者研究的方法，收集、分析與呈現研究資料與成果，使學生具備使用者研究的執行與發表能力。
description.en: From the human-centered perspective, this course explains concepts about the development and design of products and services. By practicing user research methods, students will learn how to collect and analyze the data, and present the findings of user research.

description.zh: 藉由國內外設計競賽主題與產學合作設計案進行實際演練，著重於資料蒐集、商品分析、創新構想與成果表達之進階能力養成，期讓學生在國內外設計競賽舞台上展現光芒，在產學合作中習得實務經驗並獲致產業界肯定。因此本課程旨在以實際演練達成兼具創新性與商品化專業設計能力養成。
description.en: Advanced Integrated Design educates students to identify and resolve design problems - innovatively and with sensitivity to the social, physical and ecological environment. Students learn to analyze and solve diverse design problems from technical, aesthetic, social and ecological viewpoints. Students are given the resources to identify, expand and test personal and professional development through an intensive exploration of design ideas. Innovation is stressed, along with the ability to refine formal design issues. There are numerous opportunities for students to work with industry through corporate-sponsored studio projects and design competitions.

description.zh: 本課程以『超跑人生』的思維，提供學生從現在開始，即提前佈署規劃未來的學習課程，內容涵蓋生活成長、法學知識、運動健康及生命故事分享等多面向的單元主題。本課程師資將聘任具備專業學術能力，並擁有豐富經驗的學者專家，藉由教師的專業與實務經驗，和學員共同分享與討論，激發更多的思考與促進學習。本課程除授課外，另有課程單元測驗及期末考試，學員亦須繳交課程學習報告，以作為學期成績評量分數的評比依據。
description.en: This course will help students plan their future and gain an edge in life by inviting professionals and experts from all walks of life to share their life experiences and to discuss their academic and professional expertise to stimulate ideas and encourage learning. Students will be evaluated based on short quizzes/reflection papers and a final exam.

name.zh: 拓凱超跑人生專題講座

class.name: 人文與社會科學學院(大)

notes: 先鋒,限大三大四學生修讀,以人社院學生優先

description.zh: 我們的事業甚至人生成功與否，不是建立在我們獲得與貢獻多少，而是在獲得與付出的過程中，我們是否樂在其中。能否在此過程中進行創意性思考，無疑是決定我們是否樂在其中的關鍵。本課程至少包括下述和「創意思考」相關的課題：它的神經科學基礎，它的心理學方法，它在哲學與邏輯上的認識論基礎，如何培養創意思考的基因，如何區別個人進行與在團體中運用創意思考，等等。本課程將進行系列的理論與個案探討，使學習者不僅知道什麼是「創意思考」，更要能夠進行創意思考。
description.en: Whether our careers and even our lives are successful or not is contingent not just upon the results we produce, but also upon whether we enjoy the activity of achieving those results. To achieve this goal, we need to be able to think creatively. The course hence covers at least the following topics relevant to “Creative Thinking”: its neuroscientific basis, its psychological methods, the epistemic foundation in both philosophy and logic, the development of the gene of creative thinking, the difference between thinking creatively as an individual and in a group, etc. The course will proceed with a series of close studies of theories and practical cases, so that the participants of the course will not only know 'what is creative thinking', but also be able to think creatively.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹語言研究之重要議題並探討當前研究趨勢，含括主題如下：（一）應用語言學：語用學、言談分析、社會語言學、語料庫語言學、詞彙學；（二）外語教學：第二語言習得、科技與英語教學、內容本位語言教學、多元文化與跨文化英語教學；（三）專業英文研究與教學：科技寫作、企業/觀光/科學/醫療/管理英語、專業英語課程創新設計；（四）翻譯研究：口筆譯理論與實務、口筆譯教學、翻譯與科技、影視翻譯、新聞翻譯；（五）雙語教育：英語授課、學科內容與語言整合教學、雙語教師之養成。
description.en: This course aims to introduce major research issues and current trends in language studies. Possible topics include, but are not limited to, the following: (1) applied linguistics: pragmatics, discourse analysis, sociolinguistics, corpus linguistics and phraseology; (2) foreign language teaching: L2 acquisition/SLA, technology and English education, content-based instruction and multi-/cross-cultural issues in English education; (3)ESP research and teaching: technical writing, English for business/tourism/medicine/technology/management, and innovations in ESP curriculum design; (4) translation studies: theory and practice of translation and interpretation, translation and interpretation teaching, translation and technology, audiovisual translation and news translation; (5) bilingual education and bilingualism: English medium instruction (EMI), content and language integrated learning (CLIL) and bilingual teacher development.

name.en: Issues and Trends in Language Studies

notes: Prof. Gale Stam/10/11~10/13密集授課

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹一些廣泛、基本及實際的微電子製造程序（其中最主要者為積體電路之製造程序）。首先說明製造方法上之三個 主要部分：擴散（diffusion）、平版照相術（lithography）及薄膜沉積（thin-film deposition）然後再介紹這些方法如何應用在各種元件所需之物理特性及元件設計有關之訊息後者則需要了解各種製造策略之目的及限制時再隨時給予介紹。
description.en: An introduction to the semiconductor manufacturing process. Courses include diffusion, microlithography and deposition.

description.zh: 各學院指定向度學分規定如下： 機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 電資學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分。 設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 人社學院：社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 修完學院指定向度課程12學分，剩餘6學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業18學分。
description.en: The dimension credits stipulated by each college are as follows： College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Engineering： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Management： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the nature and science curriculum. College of Design： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break　or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the technique-orientated Ph.D. students . During the semester, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry / business-oriented agencies working as a full-time R & D practical job. Course takers are in addition to developing technology-oriented doctoral level academic theory, but also has practical experience in the industry, to become a highly specialized personnel with practical professional skills.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters. The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis. After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期、或寒假(可跨學期)至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之校外研發機構的實務研究總累計時數不得低於320小時(於(跨)學期中、暑期、或寒假期間)，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究心得報告予指導教授，指導教師依據研究生之實務研發紀錄及心得報告，指導研究生撰寫成實務研究成果報告，彙交所屬系所保存，並作為成績核定之依據。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%，各系所得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the regular semester term or the summer/winter break, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on site research. The students are urged to take an active part in the training programs as well as observe and emulate the genuine research and development operations in respective manufacturers. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours (during the regular semester term and/or the summer/winter break). After the students finish the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site.

description.zh: 為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，並於開學前向各系提出申請，由本系專任老師擔任指導教師，審查計畫及評核學期成績。
description.en: This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it.

interdisciplinary: 面板微學程

description.zh: 本課程是為了培養學生自主學習的能力，由學生主動提出自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題中，學習到思考與問題解決的能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習。學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定學習計畫，於開學前向辦公室提出申請。由專任老師擔任指導教師，審查及評核學期成績。
description.en: This course is to cultivate students' self-learning ability, and students take the initiative to put forward topics they are interested in. Students learn the ability to think and solve problems in specific topics. Teachers play the role of auxiliary guidance to guide students to learn from practice. Students formulate learning plans based on their interests and abilities, and apply to the office before the start of the semester. The full-time teacher acts as the instructor to review and evaluate the semester results.

description.zh: (1) 藉由學生主動實現自己有興趣之主題，培養自我學習能力。(2) 於特定的主題當中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。(3) 教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習與成長。(4) 學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定學習計畫，並於開學前提出申請，由專任教師指導，審查及評核學期成績。
description.en: (1) Develop self-learning skills by actively implementing topics of interest to students(2) Among the specific topics, the ability to think critically and solve problems is learned.(3) Teachers act as mentors and guide students to learn and grow from practice(4) Students set up learning plans according to their own interests and abilities, and apply before the school starts. They are supervised by full-time teachers to review and evaluate semester performance.

description.en: To help students cultivate the ability of self-learning, this course allows students to engage themselves in developing course content, to plan and to execute a real-world project. "Active learning" encourages students to learn by interaction, communication, collaboration, critically analyzing arguments, and problem-solving. Instructors will assist to guide and to support in the process of learning. Students are expected to develop a process to solve real-life problems collaboratively. Written reports and oral presentations are required for course evaluation.

interdisciplinary: 面板微學程

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至光電工程相關機構連續實習18週，工時可彈性安排週間但每週不得低於32小時。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. Students will work at an electro-optical engineering related company or research organizations for 18 weeks(flexible working hours and 32 hours at least per week) during the semester. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

name.zh: 彈性工時學期校外實習

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得短期體驗光電產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a electric-optic engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至光電工程相關機構連續實習18週，每週不得低於2.5天。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核，學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師評定實習成績。

Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須於學期中至學校認可之校外電機相關機構連續實習18週，每週不得低於2.5天(20小時)。學生實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明並應依據本系規定繳交實習相關成果報告，彙交本系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance students’ on-job practical experiences. Students will work at electrical-engineering related companies or research organizations recognized by the school for 18 weeks, at least 2.5 days (20 hours) per week during the semester. After students complete their internships, the internship certificates must be issued by the internship institutions and the relevant internship reports should be submitted in accordance with the regulations of the Department of Electrical Engineering for preservation and used as the basis for the assessment of grades.

description.zh: 校務研究是教育數據分析在教育場域的應用，在真實的教育場域中應用所學的教育數據分析技術，並針對所服務的教育機構，提供有科學意義且淺顯易懂的數據分析報告，以支持教育機構進行校務運作與教學活動的改善。本門課程首先讓學生認識各職能部門的核心項目及衍伸的校務研究議題；其次瞭解教育場域中因應各項校務與教學活動所出現的數據結構類型；接著教授學生使用教育場域中的真實數據，執行包括數據清理、數據調處、數據水平與垂直整併等步驟，以獨立生成有意義的數據結構；最後則聚焦在教育方案的效果分析，以及將數據分析資料視覺化，輔以淺顯易懂的數據解讀報告，增加學員對於數據分析結果的瞭解。
description.en: Institutional research is the field where the data science can apply in the education. In the educational field, institutional researchers must use their knowledge and techniques in the educational data analytics, providing the scientific report in a friendly manner to their affiliation. Those scientific report is aimed to improve the institutional operation and the teaching activities. This course would first introduce the function of each office at the university and the institution research topic those offices have interest. Then, the data structure which is commonly seen in the educational field would be introduced followed by a series of training on the data manipulation. Last, this course will teach the students how to conduct the educational program evaluation, data visualization, data analysis and the result interpretation.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓研究生可以利用學期中、暑期、或寒假(可跨學期)至指導教授認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實務研發，以增進研究生之實務研究能力。研究生於指導教授認可之校外研發機構的實務研究總累計時數不得低於320小時(於(跨)學期中、暑期、或寒假期間)，研究生於校外實務研發期滿後，由校外研發機構出具研究生於該機構之實務研發證明與實務研究成績；研究生並且必須繳交實務研發紀錄及實務研究成果報告予指導教授並彙交所屬系所保存。研究生校外實務研究學期成績之評定比例原則：校外實務研發機構占50%，研究生指導教授占50%。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to promote an all-round ability for the graduate students at NTUT. During either the regular semester term or the summer/winter break, graduate students are required to go to the organizations or agencies with respect to their individual research topics and future development by undergoing the on-site research. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students finish the requirements, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates in accordance with the real performance on site. The students will also need to present to the thesis advisor the on-site research documents which will be deposited in the graduate institute office. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organizations or agencies (50%), respectively.
